 444: 
 445:     private void persistReplayTimingsSafely(long runId, Long loadHistoricalDataNs,
 446:                                             Long verifyEventResolutionNs, Long buildReplayDatasetNs,
 447:                                             Long generateFreshSignalsNs, Long shadowExecutionNs,
 448:                                             Long parityComparisonNs, long replayTotalNs) {
 449:         try {
 450:             jdbcTemplate.update("""
 451:                     UPDATE analysis_test_run
 452:                     SET timing_load_historical_ns=?, timing_verify_event_resolution_ns=?,
 453:                         timing_build_replay_dataset_ns=?, timing_generate_fresh_signals_ns=?,
 454:                         timing_shadow_execution_ns=?, timing_parity_comparison_ns=?, timing_total_ns=?
 455:                     WHERE id=?
 456:                     """, loadHistoricalDataNs, verifyEventResolutionNs, buildReplayDatasetNs,
 457:                     generateFreshSignalsNs, shadowExecutionNs, parityComparisonNs, replayTotalNs, runId);
 458:         } catch (Exception timingPersistenceFailure) {
 459:             log.error("FIX-11J: unable to persist Replay timing diagnostics for run {}",
 460:                     runId, timingPersistenceFailure);
 461:         }
 462:     }
 463: 
 464:     /**
 465:      * FIX-11H: loads one immutable replay dataset. The prefix comes from the exact existing
 466:      * closed/as-of query, so missing candle gaps cannot shorten history. The forward segment
 467:      * explicitly requires closed=true. No Production caller reaches this method.
 468:      */
 469:     private ReplayDataset loadDataset(String symbol, String btcSymbol, Instant start, Instant end) {
 470:         Map<ReplayDataset.CandleKey, List<Candle>> candleMap = new HashMap<>();
 471:         Set<String> symbols = new LinkedHashSet<>(List.of(symbol, btcSymbol));
 472:         int historyLimit = technicalIndicatorService.regressionHistoryLimit();
 473:         for (String sym : symbols) {
 474:             for (String interval : List.of("1m", "5m", "1h")) {
 475:                 List<Candle> prefix = new java.util.ArrayList<>(candleRepository.findClosedCandlesAtOrBefore(
 476:                         sym, interval, start, PageRequest.of(0, historyLimit)));
 477:                 java.util.Collections.reverse(prefix);
 478:                 List<Candle> forward = candleRepository
 479:                         .findBySymbolAndIntervalCodeAndClosedTrueAndOpenTimeBetweenOrderByOpenTimeAsc(
 480:                                 sym, interval, start, end);
 481:                 List<Candle> merged = new java.util.ArrayList<>(prefix.size() + forward.size());
 482:                 merged.addAll(prefix);
 483:                 Instant prefixEnd = prefix.isEmpty() ? Instant.EPOCH : prefix.get(prefix.size() - 1).getOpenTime();
 484:                 forward.stream().filter(c -> c.getOpenTime().isAfter(prefixEnd)).forEach(merged::add);
 485:                 candleMap.put(new ReplayDataset.CandleKey(sym, interval), merged);
 486:                 log.info("FIX-11H dataset candles: symbol={}, interval={}, prefix={}, forward={}, merged={}",
 487:                         sym, interval, prefix.size(), forward.size(), merged.size());
 488:             }
 489:         }
 490: 
 491:         Map<ReplayDataset.SignalKey, Long> lineage = new HashMap<>();
 492:         // FIX-11H / FIX-112D: lineage is candle identity, not signal persistence timing.
 493:         // Recovery/backfilled Production signals can be generated hours after their candle, so
 494:         // generatedAt MUST NOT define this preload window. Select and match lineage by the same
 495:         // exact candleOpenTime identity used by ReplayDataset.sourceSignalId().
 496:         for (TradeSignal signal : signalRepository.findBySymbolAndCandleOpenTimeBetweenOrderByCandleOpenTimeAsc(symbol, start, end)) {
 497:             ReplayDataset.SignalKey key = new ReplayDataset.SignalKey(
 498:                     signal.getSymbol(), signal.getInterval(), signal.getCandleOpenTime());
 499:             Long previous = lineage.putIfAbsent(key, signal.getId());
 500:             if (previous != null && !previous.equals(signal.getId())) {
 501:                 throw new IllegalStateException("Replay lineage invariant violated for " + key
 502:                         + ": signalIds=" + previous + "," + signal.getId());
 503:             }
 504:         }
 505:         log.info("FIX-11H dataset lineage: symbol={}, entries={}", symbol, lineage.size());
 506:         return new ReplayDataset(candleMap, lineage);
 507:     }
 508: 
 509:     private List<Candle> candles(String symbol, String interval, Instant start, Instant end) {
 510:         return candleRepository.findBySymbolAndIntervalCodeAndOpenTimeBetweenOrderByOpenTimeAsc(
 511:                 symbol, interval, start, end);
 512:     }
 513: 
 514:     private int verifyEventResolution(long runId, String symbol, String interval, List<Candle> candles,
 515:                                       int progressStart, int progressEnd) {
 516:         int resolved = 0;
 517:         int size = candles.size();
 518:         for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
 519:             checkStopRequested(runId);
 520:             Candle candle = candles.get(i);
 521:             List<Candle> latestAtEvent = candleRepository.findClosedCandlesAtOrBefore(
 522:                     symbol, interval, candle.getOpenTime(), PageRequest.of(0, 1));
 523:             if (!latestAtEvent.isEmpty() && candle.getOpenTime().equals(latestAtEvent.get(0).getOpenTime())) {
 524:                 resolved++;
 525:             }
 526:             if (i % 25 == 0 && size > 0) {
 527:                 int p = progressStart + (int) Math.round((progressEnd - progressStart) * (i / (double) size));
 528:                 updateRun(runId, "RUNNING", p,
 529:                         "Replaying " + interval + " candle " + (i + 1) + "/" + size, null);
 530:             }
 531:         }
 532:         return resolved;
 533:     }
 534: 
 535:     private FreshReplayStats generateFreshSignals(
 536:             long runId,
 537:             String symbol,
 538:             Instant executionStart,
 539:             Instant executionEnd,
 540:             List<Candle> oneMinuteCandles,
 541:             List<Candle> fiveMinuteCandles,
 542:             List<Candle> oneHourCandles,
 543:             String btcSymbol,
 544:             List<Candle> btcOneMinuteCandles,
 545:             List<Candle> btcFiveMinuteCandles,
 546:             List<Candle> btcOneHourCandles,
 547:             ReplayDataSource dataSource,
 548:             ReplayDataset replayDataset
 549:     ) {
 550:         List<ReplayCandle> timeline = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
 551:         oneMinuteCandles.forEach(c -> timeline.add(new ReplayCandle(symbol, "1m", c, true)));
 552:         fiveMinuteCandles.forEach(c -> timeline.add(new ReplayCandle(symbol, "5m", c, true)));
 553:         oneHourCandles.forEach(c -> timeline.add(new ReplayCandle(symbol, "1h", c, true)));
 554:         btcOneMinuteCandles.forEach(c -> timeline.add(new ReplayCandle(btcSymbol, "1m", c, false)));
 555:         btcFiveMinuteCandles.forEach(c -> timeline.add(new ReplayCandle(btcSymbol, "5m", c, false)));
 556:         btcOneHourCandles.forEach(c -> timeline.add(new ReplayCandle(btcSymbol, "1h", c, false)));
 557:         timeline.sort(java.util.Comparator
 558:                 .comparing((ReplayCandle rc) -> rc.candle().getOpenTime().plusSeconds(intervalSeconds(rc.interval())))
 559:                 .thenComparingInt(rc -> intervalOrder(rc.interval()))
 560:                 .thenComparingInt(rc -> rc.primary() ? 1 : 0));
 561: 
 562:         int oneMinuteSignals = 0, fiveMinuteSignals = 0, oneHourSignals = 0;
 563:         int oneMinuteBuys = 0, fiveMinuteBuys = 0, oneHourBuys = 0;
 564:         int buys = 0, watches = 0, sells = 0, strongSells = 0, errors = 0;
 565:         java.util.List<TradeSignal> generatedSignals = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
 566: 
 567:         // FIX-11L: Replay-only deep profiling for the Generate fresh signals stage.
 568:         // These monotonic timers observe existing calls only; they do not alter inputs,
 569:         // call ordering, persistence, thresholds, or any Production trading behavior.
 570:         ReplayFreshSignalProfiler profiler = new ReplayFreshSignalProfiler(runId, dataSource);
 571:         // FIX-11M: Enable aggregate timing only for this Replay worker thread.
 572:         // The shared AnalysisService decision path is unchanged; this is observation-only.
 573:         analysisService.beginReplayAnalysisProfiling(runId);
 574:         try (ExecutionReplayScope.Scope ignored = replayScope.open(runId, List.of(), o -> {})) {
 575:         // FIX-043 Replay parity: fresh Replay has always generated technical snapshots/signals
 576:         // chronologically for EVERY closed candle in the timeline. Production now restores the
 577:         // same no-gap contract with asynchronous close-event processing plus chronological recovery.
 578:         // Do not "optimize" Replay by sampling every Nth candle or by copying the production recovery
 579:         // scheduler cadence; that would recreate the exact 1m->~5m blind-gap incident FIX-043 fixes.
 580:         for (int index = 0; index < timeline.size(); index++) {
 581:             checkStopRequested(runId);
 582:             ReplayCandle replay = timeline.get(index);
 583:             Candle candle = replay.candle();
 584:             Instant evaluationTime = candle.getOpenTime().plusSeconds(intervalSeconds(replay.interval()));
 585:             boolean inRequestedWindow = !evaluationTime.isBefore(executionStart) && !evaluationTime.isAfter(executionEnd);
 586:             try {
 587:                 long operationStartedNs = System.nanoTime();
 588:                 java.util.Optional<IndicatorSnapshot> snapshot;
 589:                 try {
 590:                     snapshot = dataSource == ReplayDataSource.DATASET
 591:                             ? technicalIndicatorService.calculateSnapshotForRegression(
 592:                                     replay.symbol(), replay.interval(), candle.getOpenTime(), replayDataset)
 593:                             : technicalIndicatorService.calculateSnapshotForRegression(
 594:                                     replay.symbol(), replay.interval(), candle.getOpenTime());
 595:                 } finally {
 596:                     profiler.recordSnapshot(System.nanoTime() - operationStartedNs);
 597:                 }
 598:                 if (snapshot.isEmpty()) {
 599:                     if (inRequestedWindow) {
 600:                         errors++;
 601:                         saveGenerationError(runId, replay.symbol(), replay.interval(), candle,
 602:                                 "Not enough historical candles to calculate the technical snapshot");
 603:                     }
 604:                     continue;
 605:                 }
 606: 
 607:                 // Do not generate a signal whose candle would only have closed after the
 608:                 // requested test end. Warm-up rows before executionStart are intentionally
 609:                 // generated for as-of context, but are not counted or displayed as test output.
 610:                 if (evaluationTime.isAfter(executionEnd)) continue;
 611: 
 612:                 replayScope.reference(evaluationTime);
 613:                 operationStartedNs = System.nanoTime();
 614:                 TradeSignal generated;
 615:                 try {
 616:                     generated = analysisService.analyzeForRegression(snapshot.get(), evaluationTime);
 617:                 } finally {
 618:                     profiler.recordAnalysis(System.nanoTime() - operationStartedNs);
 619:                 }
 620:                 replayScope.appendSignal(generated);
 621:                 SignalDecision decision = generated.getDecision();
 622:                 if (replay.primary()) generatedSignals.add(generated);
 623: 
 624:                 if (replay.primary() && inRequestedWindow) {
 625:                     if ("1m".equals(replay.interval())) { oneMinuteSignals++; if (isBuy(decision)) oneMinuteBuys++; }
 626:                     else if ("5m".equals(replay.interval())) { fiveMinuteSignals++; if (isBuy(decision)) fiveMinuteBuys++; }
 627:                     else if ("1h".equals(replay.interval())) { oneHourSignals++; if (isBuy(decision)) oneHourBuys++; }
 628: 
 629:                     if (decision == SignalDecision.BUY || decision == SignalDecision.STRONG_BUY) buys++;
 630:                     else if (decision == SignalDecision.WATCH) watches++;
 631:                     else if (decision == SignalDecision.SELL) sells++;
 632:                     else if (decision == SignalDecision.STRONG_SELL) strongSells++;
 633: 
 634:                     operationStartedNs = System.nanoTime();
 635:                     try {
 636:                         jdbcTemplate.update("""
 637:                             INSERT INTO analysis_test_signal
 638:                                 (test_run_id, source_signal_id, replay_generated, symbol, interval_code, candle_open_time,
 639:                                  generated_at, latest_price, original_decision, final_decision,
 640:                                  execution_effective_decision, total_score, confidence_score, raw_confidence_score,
 641:                                  effective_confidence_score, primary_blocking_stage, detected_regime, candidate_regime,
 642:                                  confirmed_regime, regime_candidate_count, entry_authority, entry_authority_max_position_percent,
 643:                                  trend_score, volume_score, momentum_score, decision_authority_corrected, generation_error)
 644:                             VALUES (?, NULL, 1, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 0, NULL)
 645:                             """,
 646:                             runId, replay.symbol(), replay.interval(), Timestamp.from(candle.getOpenTime()),
 647:                             Timestamp.from(evaluationTime), generated.getLatestPrice(),
 648:                             generated.getOriginalDecision() == null ? null : generated.getOriginalDecision().name(),
 649:                             decision == null ? null : decision.name(),
 650:                             decision == null ? null : decision.name(),
 651:                             generated.getTotalScore(), generated.getConfidenceScore(), generated.getRawConfidenceScore(),
 652:                             generated.getEffectiveConfidenceScore(), generated.getPrimaryBlockingStage(),
 653:                             generated.getDetectedRegime() == null ? null : generated.getDetectedRegime().name(),
 654:                             generated.getCandidateRegime() == null ? null : generated.getCandidateRegime().name(),
 655:                             generated.getConfirmedRegime() == null ? null : generated.getConfirmedRegime().name(),
 656:                             generated.getRegimeCandidateCount(), generated.getEntryAuthority(),
 657:                             generated.getEntryAuthorityMaxPositionPercent(), generated.getTrendScore(),
 658:                             generated.getVolumeScore(), generated.getMomentumScore());
 659:                     } finally {
 660:                         profiler.recordAnalysisTestSignalPersistence(System.nanoTime() - operationStartedNs);
 661:                     }
 662: 
 663:                     // FIX-069: Persist the exact production TradeSignal shape as replay output.
 664:                     // analysis_test_signal remains for backward-compatible diagnostics, while
 665:                     // trade_signal_test is the canonical parity table used for field-by-field comparison.
 666:                     // FIX-112D: Replay lineage uses exact market-candle identity, never
 667:                     // generated_at or nearest-time matching. A legitimate Replay-only
 668:                     // signal remains NULL. This metadata lookup cannot alter Production.
 669:                     operationStartedNs = System.nanoTime();
 670:                     Long sourceSignalId;
 671:                     try {
 672:                         sourceSignalId = dataSource == ReplayDataSource.DATASET
 673:                                 ? replayDataset.sourceSignalId(
 674:                                         generated.getSymbol(), generated.getInterval(), generated.getCandleOpenTime())
 675:                                 : signalRepository.findBySymbolAndIntervalAndCandleOpenTime(
 676:                                         generated.getSymbol(), generated.getInterval(), generated.getCandleOpenTime())
 677:                                         .map(TradeSignal::getId).orElse(null);
 678:                     } finally {
 679:                         profiler.recordLineageLookup(System.nanoTime() - operationStartedNs);
 680:                     }
 681:                     operationStartedNs = System.nanoTime();
 682:                     try {
 683:                         persistTradeSignalTest(runId, generated, sourceSignalId, null);
 684:                     } finally {
 685:                         profiler.recordTradeSignalTestPersistence(System.nanoTime() - operationStartedNs);
 686:                     }
 687:                 }
 688:             } catch (ReplayCancellationException stop) {
 689:                 throw stop;
 690:             } catch (Exception exception) {
 691:                 if (replay.primary() && inRequestedWindow) {
 692:                     errors++;
 693:                     saveGenerationError(runId, replay.symbol(), replay.interval(), candle, errorDetail(exception, 900));
 694:                 }
 695:                 log.warn("Regression fresh-signal generation failed: run={}, symbol={}, interval={}, candle={}",
 696:                         runId, replay.symbol(), replay.interval(), candle.getOpenTime(), exception);
 697:             }
 698: 
 699:             if (index % 10 == 0 && !timeline.isEmpty()) {
 700:                 int progress = 43 + (int) Math.round(30d * index / timeline.size());
 701:                 long progressStartedNs = System.nanoTime();
 702:                 try {
 703:                     updateRun(runId, "RUNNING", Math.min(73, progress),
 704:                             "Generating fresh signal " + (index + 1) + "/" + timeline.size(), null);
 705:                 } finally {
 706:                     profiler.recordProgressUpdate(System.nanoTime() - progressStartedNs);
 707:                 }
 708:             }
 709:         }
 710: 
 711:         } finally {
 712:             // FIX-11M must never turn a valid Replay into ERROR if diagnostic summary logging fails.
 713:             try {
 714:                 analysisService.finishReplayAnalysisProfiling(runId);
 715:             } catch (Exception profilingException) {
 716:                 log.warn("FIX11M_REPLAY_ANALYSIS_PROFILE_ERROR run={} message={} productionMutation=false replayDecisionMutation=false",
 717:                         runId, profilingException.getMessage());
 718:             }
 719:             profiler.logSummary(log, timeline.size());
 720:         }
 721:         return new FreshReplayStats(oneMinuteSignals, oneMinuteBuys, fiveMinuteSignals, fiveMinuteBuys,
 722:                 oneHourSignals, oneHourBuys, buys, watches, sells, strongSells, errors, generatedSignals);
 723:     }
 724: 
 725:     private void saveGenerationError(long runId, String symbol, String interval, Candle candle, String error) {
 726:         jdbcTemplate.update("""
 727:                 INSERT INTO analysis_test_signal
 728:                     (test_run_id, source_signal_id, replay_generated, symbol, interval_code, candle_open_time,
 729:                      generated_at, latest_price, decision_authority_corrected, generation_error)
 730:                 VALUES (?, NULL, 1, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 0, ?)
 731:                 """, runId, symbol, interval, Timestamp.from(candle.getOpenTime()),
 732:                 Timestamp.from(candle.getOpenTime().plusSeconds(intervalSeconds(interval))),
 733:                 candle.getClosePrice(), error);
 734:     }
 735: 
 736:     /**
 737:      * FIX-069: write every field mapped by the TradeSignal JPA entity into trade_signal_test.
 738:      * Reflection is intentional here: whenever production TradeSignal gains another @Column,
 739:      * replay inherits it automatically instead of drifting behind a hand-maintained test schema.
 740:      */
 741:     private void persistTradeSignalTest(long runId, TradeSignal signal, Long sourceSignalId, String generationError) {
 742:         try {
 743:             java.util.List<String> columns = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
 744:             java.util.List<Object> values = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
 745:             columns.add("test_run_id"); values.add(runId);
 746:             // FIX-112D / Replay=Production audit lineage: this ID points only to the
 747:             // exact Production signal for the same symbol + interval + candle_open_time.
 748:             // It is additive Replay metadata and is never an execution authority.
 749:             columns.add("source_signal_id"); values.add(sourceSignalId);
 750:             columns.add("replay_generated"); values.add(1);
 751:             columns.add("generation_error"); values.add(generationError);
 752: 
 753:             for (Field field : TradeSignal.class.getDeclaredFields()) {
 754:                 if ("id".equals(field.getName()) || "createdAt".equals(field.getName())) continue;
 755:                 Column column = field.getAnnotation(Column.class);
 756:                 if (column == null) continue;
 757:                 field.setAccessible(true);
 758:                 Object value = field.get(signal);
 759:                 if (value instanceof Enum<?> e) value = e.name();
 760:                 if (value instanceof Instant instant) value = Timestamp.from(instant);
 761:                 String columnName = column.name();
 762:                 if (columnName == null || columnName.isBlank()) columnName = snakeCase(field.getName());
 763:                 columns.add(columnName);
 764:                 values.add(value);
 765:             }
 766: 
 767:             String placeholders = String.join(",", java.util.Collections.nCopies(values.size(), "?"));
 768:             jdbcTemplate.update("INSERT INTO trade_signal_test (" + String.join(",", columns) + ") VALUES (" + placeholders + ")", values.toArray());
 769:         } catch (Exception e) {
 770:             throw new IllegalStateException("Unable to persist production-shaped replay TradeSignal", e);
 771:         }
 772:     }
 773: 
 774:     private String snakeCase(String value) {
 775:         return value.replaceAll("([a-z0-9])([A-Z])", "$1_$2").toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
 776:     }
 777: 
 778:     private long intervalSeconds(String interval) {
 779:         return switch (interval) {
 780:             case "1m" -> 60L;
 781:             case "5m" -> 300L;
 782:             case "1h" -> 3600L;
 783:             default -> 60L;
 784:         };
 785:     }
 786: 
 787:     private int intervalOrder(String interval) {
 788:         return switch (interval) {
 789:             case "1h" -> 0;
 790:             case "5m" -> 1;
 791:             default -> 2;
 792:         };
 793:     }

 795:     private boolean isBuy(SignalDecision decision) {
 796:         return decision == SignalDecision.BUY || decision == SignalDecision.STRONG_BUY;
 797:     }
 798: 
 799:     /**
 800:      * FIX-11L Replay-only profiler for the fresh-signal generation loop. It deliberately
 801:      * aggregates timings in memory and emits one summary log after the stage; there are no
 802:      * per-signal log writes and no Production/shared-analysis branches.
 803:      */
 804:     private static final class ReplayFreshSignalProfiler {
 805:         private final long runId;
 806:         private final ReplayDataSource dataSource;
 807:         private final long startedNs = System.nanoTime();
 808:         private long snapshotNs;
 809:         private long analysisNs;
 810:         private long analysisTestSignalPersistenceNs;
 811:         private long lineageLookupNs;
 812:         private long tradeSignalTestPersistenceNs;
 813:         private long progressUpdateNs;
 814:         private long snapshotCalls;
 815:         private long analysisCalls;
 816:         private long analysisTestSignalPersistenceCalls;
 817:         private long lineageLookupCalls;
 818:         private long tradeSignalTestPersistenceCalls;
 819:         private long progressUpdateCalls;
 820:         private long maxSnapshotNs;
 821:         private long maxAnalysisNs;
 822: 
 823:         private ReplayFreshSignalProfiler(long runId, ReplayDataSource dataSource) {
 824:             this.runId = runId;
 825:             this.dataSource = dataSource;
 826:         }
 827: 
 828:         private void recordSnapshot(long elapsedNs) {
 829:             snapshotNs += elapsedNs;
 830:             snapshotCalls++;
 831:             maxSnapshotNs = Math.max(maxSnapshotNs, elapsedNs);
 832:         }
 833: 
 834:         private void recordAnalysis(long elapsedNs) {
 835:             analysisNs += elapsedNs;
 836:             analysisCalls++;
 837:             maxAnalysisNs = Math.max(maxAnalysisNs, elapsedNs);
 838:         }
 839: 
 840:         private void recordAnalysisTestSignalPersistence(long elapsedNs) {
 841:             analysisTestSignalPersistenceNs += elapsedNs;
 842:             analysisTestSignalPersistenceCalls++;
 843:         }
 844: 
 845:         private void recordLineageLookup(long elapsedNs) {
 846:             lineageLookupNs += elapsedNs;
 847:             lineageLookupCalls++;
 848:         }
 849: 
 850:         private void recordTradeSignalTestPersistence(long elapsedNs) {
 851:             tradeSignalTestPersistenceNs += elapsedNs;
 852:             tradeSignalTestPersistenceCalls++;
 853:         }
 854: 
 855:         private void recordProgressUpdate(long elapsedNs) {
 856:             progressUpdateNs += elapsedNs;
 857:             progressUpdateCalls++;
 858:         }
 859: 
 860:         private void logSummary(org.slf4j.Logger logger, int timelineSize) {
 861:             long totalNs = System.nanoTime() - startedNs;
 862:             long measuredNs = snapshotNs + analysisNs + analysisTestSignalPersistenceNs
 863:                     + lineageLookupNs + tradeSignalTestPersistenceNs + progressUpdateNs;
 864:             long otherNs = Math.max(0L, totalNs - measuredNs);
 865:             logger.info(
 866:                     "FIX11L_REPLAY_SIGNAL_PROFILE run={} dataSource={} timeline={} totalMs={} "
 867:                             + "snapshotMs={} snapshotCalls={} snapshotAvgMs={} snapshotMaxMs={} "
 868:                             + "analysisMs={} analysisCalls={} analysisAvgMs={} analysisMaxMs={} "
 869:                             + "analysisTestSignalPersistMs={} analysisTestSignalPersistCalls={} "
 870:                             + "lineageMs={} lineageCalls={} tradeSignalTestPersistMs={} tradeSignalTestPersistCalls={} "
 871:                             + "progressMs={} progressCalls={} otherMs={} productionMutation=false replayDecisionMutation=false",
 872:                     runId, dataSource, timelineSize, millis(totalNs),
 873:                     millis(snapshotNs), snapshotCalls, averageMillis(snapshotNs, snapshotCalls), millis(maxSnapshotNs),
 874:                     millis(analysisNs), analysisCalls, averageMillis(analysisNs, analysisCalls), millis(maxAnalysisNs),
 875:                     millis(analysisTestSignalPersistenceNs), analysisTestSignalPersistenceCalls,
 876:                     millis(lineageLookupNs), lineageLookupCalls, millis(tradeSignalTestPersistenceNs),
 877:                     tradeSignalTestPersistenceCalls, millis(progressUpdateNs), progressUpdateCalls, millis(otherNs));
 878:         }
 879: 
 880:         private static String millis(long ns) {
 881:             return String.format(java.util.Locale.ROOT, "%.3f", ns / 1_000_000.0d);
 882:         }
 883: 
 884:         private static String averageMillis(long ns, long calls) {
 885:             return calls == 0L ? "0.000"
 886:                     : String.format(java.util.Locale.ROOT, "%.3f", (ns / 1_000_000.0d) / calls);
 887:         }
 888:     }

 890:     private record ReplayCandle(String symbol, String interval, Candle candle, boolean primary) {}
 891: 
 892:     private record FreshReplayStats(
 893:             int oneMinuteSignals, int oneMinuteBuys,
 894:             int fiveMinuteSignals, int fiveMinuteBuys,
 895:             int oneHourSignals, int oneHourBuys,
 896:             int buys, int watches, int sells, int strongSells, int errors,
 897:             java.util.List<TradeSignal> generatedSignals
 898:     ) {
 899:         int total() { return oneMinuteSignals + fiveMinuteSignals + oneHourSignals; }
 900:     }

 902:     private List<Candle> candlesInExecutionWindow(List<Candle> candles, String interval, Instant start, Instant end) {
 903:         return candles.stream()
 904:                 .filter(c -> {
 905:                     Instant t = c.getOpenTime().plusSeconds(intervalSeconds(interval));
 906:                     return !t.isBefore(start) && !t.isAfter(end);
 907:                 })
 908:                 .toList();
 909:     }

 911:     private int countSignals(List<TradeSignal> signals, String interval) {
 912:         return (int) signals.stream().filter(s -> interval.equals(s.getInterval())).count();
 913:     }

 915:     private boolean isBearish(SignalDecision decision) {
 916:         return decision == SignalDecision.SELL || decision == SignalDecision.STRONG_SELL;
 917:     }

 919:     private void updateRun(long runId, String status, int progress, String step, String error) {
 920:         jdbcTemplate.update("""
 921:                 UPDATE analysis_test_run
 922:                 SET status=?, progress_percent=?, current_step=?, error_message=?,
 923:                     started_at=COALESCE(started_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)), heartbeat_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
 924:                 WHERE id=?
 925:                 """, status, Math.max(0, Math.min(100, progress)), step, error, runId);
 926:     }

 930:     private String currentStep(long runId) {
 931:         try {
 932:             return jdbcTemplate.queryForObject(
 933:                     "SELECT current_step FROM analysis_test_run WHERE id = ?", String.class, runId);
 934:         } catch (Exception ignored) {
 935:             return "Unknown regression phase";
 936:         }
 937:     }
 938: 
 939:     private Throwable rootCause(Throwable exception) {
 940:         if (exception == null) return null;
 941:         Throwable root = exception;
 942:         while (root.getCause() != null && root.getCause() != root) {
 943:             root = root.getCause();
 944:         }
 945:         return root;
 946:     }
 947: 
 948:     private String rootCauseDetail(Throwable root, int max) {
 949:         if (root == null) return "Unknown root cause";
 950:         String message = root.getMessage();
 951:         String detail = root.getClass().getName() + (message == null || message.isBlank() ? "" : ": " + message);
 952:         return abbreviate(detail, max);
 953:     }
 954: 
 955:     private String stackTrace(Throwable exception) {
 956:         if (exception == null) return "Unknown regression test error";
 957:         StringWriter buffer = new StringWriter();
 958:         try (PrintWriter writer = new PrintWriter(buffer)) {
 959:             exception.printStackTrace(writer);
 960:         }
 961:         return buffer.toString();
 962:     }
 963: 
 964:     private Instant toInstant(Object value) {
 965:         if (value instanceof Timestamp timestamp) return timestamp.toInstant();
 966:         if (value instanceof Instant instant) return instant;
 967:         if (value instanceof LocalDateTime localDateTime) return localDateTime.toInstant(ZoneOffset.UTC);
 968:         throw new IllegalStateException("Unsupported regression timestamp value: " + value);
 969:     }
 970: 
 971: 
 972:     private String errorDetail(Throwable exception, int max) {
 973:         if (exception == null) return "Unknown regression test error";
 974:         Throwable root = exception;
 975:         while (root.getCause() != null && root.getCause() != root) {
 976:             root = root.getCause();
 977:         }
 978:         StringBuilder detail = new StringBuilder()
 979:                 .append(exception.getClass().getName())
 980:                 .append(": ")
 981:                 .append(exception.getMessage() == null ? exception.toString() : exception.getMessage());
 982:         if (root != exception) {
 983:             detail.append(" | Root cause: ")
 984:                     .append(root.getClass().getName())
 985:                     .append(": ")
 986:                     .append(root.getMessage() == null ? root.toString() : root.getMessage());
 987:         }
 988:         return abbreviate(detail.toString(), max);
 989:     }
 990: 
 991:     private String abbreviate(String value, int max) {
 992:         if (value == null) return "Unknown regression test error";
 993:         return value.length() <= max ? value : value.substring(0, max);
 994:     }
 995: 
 996: 
 997: }

 115:     /**

 118:      * fired, which could falsely mark a replay created by the current JVM as interrupted.

 121:      * created after this instant belongs to the current application instance and must never be
 122:      * touched by startup recovery, even if ApplicationReadyEvent is delivered later than expected.

 132:                     completed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
 133:                 WHERE status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING')
 134:                   AND created_at < ?

 142:     /**
 143:      * FIX-090: request cooperative cancellation of exactly one active replay worker.
 144:      * We do not mark the row ERROR here because that would be a false claim while Java is
 145:      * still executing. RegressionTestWorker marks ERROR only after it actually unwinds.

 147:     public synchronized Map<String, Object> stopRun(long runId) {
 148:         List<Map<String, Object>> rows = jdbcTemplate.queryForList(
 149:                 "SELECT id,status,current_step FROM analysis_test_run WHERE id=?", runId);
 150:         if (rows.isEmpty()) throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Regression test #" + runId + " not found.");
 151:         String status = String.valueOf(rows.get(0).get("status"));
 152:         if (!("PENDING".equals(status) || "RUNNING".equals(status))) {
 153:             return Map.of("id", runId, "status", status, "activeWorker", worker.isActive(runId),
 154:                     "message", "Test is already stopped.");
 155:         }
 156:         boolean requested = worker.requestStop(runId);
 157:         if (!requested) {
 158:             // No worker in this JVM means it is already orphaned/stopped. Mark it ERROR now so
 159:             // Delete Data is not blocked forever by a stale RUNNING database status.
 160:             jdbcTemplate.update("""
 161:                     UPDATE analysis_test_run
 162:                     SET status='ERROR', current_step='Stopped by user',
 163:                         error_message='Replay worker was not active in this application instance; run marked stopped.',
 164:                         completed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), heartbeat_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
 165:                     WHERE id=? AND status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING')
 166:                     """, runId);
 167:             return Map.of("id", runId, "status", "ERROR", "activeWorker", false,
 168:                     "message", "Test had no active worker and is now stopped. You can Delete Data.");
 169:         }
 170:         jdbcTemplate.update("UPDATE analysis_test_run SET current_step='Stop requested �?" waiting for replay worker to exit', heartbeat_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=?", runId);
 171:         return Map.of("id", runId, "status", "STOPPING", "activeWorker", true,
 172:                 "message", "Stop requested. Delete Data will unlock after the replay worker has fully stopped.");
 173:     }

 180:     public synchronized long start(RegressionTestRunRequest request, ReplayDataSource dataSource) {
 181:         if (request == null || request.symbol() == null || request.symbol().isBlank()
 182:                 || request.startTime() == null || request.endTime() == null
 183:                 || !request.endTime().isAfter(request.startTime())) {
 184:             throw new IllegalArgumentException("Symbol, start time and end time are required, and end must be after start.");
 185:         }
 186: 
 187:         Integer activeRuns = jdbcTemplate.queryForObject("""
 188:                 SELECT COUNT(*)
 189:                 FROM analysis_test_run
 190:                 WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')
 191:                 """, Integer.class);
 192:         if (activeRuns != null && activeRuns > 0) {
 193:             Map<String, Object> active = jdbcTemplate.queryForMap("""
 194:                     SELECT id, test_name, symbol, status, progress_percent, started_at, created_at
 195:                     FROM analysis_test_run
 196:                     WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')
 197:                     ORDER BY id DESC
 198:                     LIMIT 1
 199:                     """);
 200:             throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
 201:                     "Regression test #" + active.get("id") + " is already " + active.get("status")
 202:                             + " for " + active.get("symbol") + ". Wait for it to finish before starting another run.");
 203:         }
 204: 
 205:         String symbol = request.symbol().trim().toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
 206:         ReplayDataSource effectiveSource = dataSource == null ? ReplayDataSource.DATABASE : dataSource;
 207:         String baseTestName = request.testName() == null || request.testName().isBlank()
 208:                 ? symbol + " regression" : request.testName().trim();
 209:         String testName = (baseTestName + " [" + effectiveSource.name() + "]").substring(
 210:                 0, Math.min(180, baseTestName.length() + effectiveSource.name().length() + 3));
 211: 
 212:         KeyHolder keyHolder = new GeneratedKeyHolder();
 213:         jdbcTemplate.update(connection -> {
 214:             PreparedStatement statement = connection.prepareStatement("""
 215:                     INSERT INTO analysis_test_run
 216:                         (test_name, symbol, start_time, end_time, status, progress_percent, current_step)
 217:                     VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'PENDING', 0, 'Queued from Administration')
 218:                     """, Statement.RETURN_GENERATED_KEYS);
 219:             statement.setString(1, testName);
 220:             statement.setString(2, symbol);
 221:             statement.setTimestamp(3, Timestamp.from(request.startTime()));
 222:             statement.setTimestamp(4, Timestamp.from(request.endTime()));
 223:             return statement;
 224:         }, keyHolder);
 225: 
 226:         Number key = keyHolder.getKey();
 227:         if (key == null) {
 228:             throw new IllegalStateException("Could not create regression test run.");
 229:         }
 230:         long id = key.longValue();
 231:         // FIX-156 / RET-01: do not persist a legacy shared experiment revision
 232:         // for baseline Replay. Its fixed parity policy is recorded by the
 233:         // immutable Replay profile/certificate work, not by FIX-122 state.
 234:         worker.runAsync(id, effectiveSource);
 235:         return id;
 236:     }

 314:     @Transactional
 315:     public synchronized Map<String, Object> resetAllTestData() {
 316:         // FIX-090: Java worker ownership is authoritative. Database ERROR may be written a few
 317:         // milliseconds before runAsync finally releases ownership; never purge during that gap.
 318:         if (worker.hasActiveRuns()) {
 319:             throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
 320:                     "A Replay/Test worker is still active. Stop it and wait for the worker to fully exit before Delete Data.");
 321:         }
 322:         Integer activeRuns = jdbcTemplate.queryForObject("""
 323:                 SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_test_run
 324:                 WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')
 325:                 """, Integer.class);
 326:         if (activeRuns != null && activeRuns > 0) {
 327:             List<Map<String,Object>> liveRows = jdbcTemplate.queryForList(
 328:                     "SELECT id,status FROM analysis_test_run WHERE status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING')");
 329:             boolean workerStillActive = liveRows.stream()
 330:                     .anyMatch(r -> worker.isActive(((Number) r.get("id")).longValue()));
 331:             if (workerStillActive) {
 332:                 throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
 333:                         "A Replay/Test worker is still active. Use Stop Test and wait until it becomes ERROR before Delete Data.");
 334:             }
 335:             // Defensive cleanup for a stale DB status with no Java worker.
 336:             jdbcTemplate.update("""
 337:                     UPDATE analysis_test_run SET status='ERROR', current_step='Stopped/orphaned worker',
 338:                         error_message='No active Replay/Test worker exists in this application instance.',
 339:                         completed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
 340:                     WHERE status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING')
 341:                     """);
 342:         }
 343: 
 344:         // FIX-088: Delete Data is now a true purge, not an archive operation. Every replay/test
 345:         // table that can feed Recent Test Runs, run detail, Shadow Trades, or archived replay
 346:         // history is emptied. Persistent Proven records are deliberately excluded.
 347:         int provenBefore = countRows("proven_analyzed_trade");
 348:         int provenLegsBefore = countRows("proven_trade_leg_archive");
 349: 
 350:         Map<String, Integer> deleted = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();
 351:         // Delete children before parents so the purge remains safe if foreign keys are added later.
 352:         deleted.put("one_candle_continuation_grace_test", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM one_candle_continuation_grace_test"));
 353:         deleted.put("defensive_risk_reduction_observation_test", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM defensive_risk_reduction_observation_test"));
 354:         deleted.put("position_management_test", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM position_management_test"));
 355:         deleted.put("wallet_execution_test", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM wallet_execution_test"));
 356:         deleted.put("wallet_position_test", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM wallet_position_test"));
 357:         deleted.put("execution_opportunity_test", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM execution_opportunity_test"));
 358:         deleted.put("trade_signal_test", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM trade_signal_test"));
 359:         deleted.put("analysis_test_signal", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM analysis_test_signal"));
 360:         deleted.put("analysis_test_result", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM analysis_test_result"));
 361:         // FIX-156 / O-8: the only allowed shared diagnostic-table operation
 362:         // stays explicit and run-owned; it cannot delete a Production row.
 363:         deleted.put("fix122_evaluation", replayFix122EvaluationStore.purgeReplayRows());
 364:         deleted.put("analysis_test_run", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM analysis_test_run"));
 365: 
 366:         deleted.put("one_candle_continuation_grace_test_archive", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM one_candle_continuation_grace_test_archive"));
 367:         deleted.put("defensive_risk_reduction_observation_test_archive", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM defensive_risk_reduction_observation_test_archive"));
 368:         deleted.put("position_management_test_archive", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM position_management_test_archive"));
 369:         deleted.put("wallet_execution_test_archive", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM wallet_execution_test_archive"));
 370:         deleted.put("wallet_position_test_archive", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM wallet_position_test_archive"));
 371:         deleted.put("execution_opportunity_test_archive", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM execution_opportunity_test_archive"));
 372:         deleted.put("trade_signal_test_archive", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM trade_signal_test_archive"));
 373:         deleted.put("analysis_test_signal_archive", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM analysis_test_signal_archive"));
 374:         deleted.put("analysis_test_result_archive", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM analysis_test_result_archive"));
 375:         deleted.put("analysis_test_run_archive", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM analysis_test_run_archive"));
 376:         deleted.put("regression_test_archive_batch", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM regression_test_archive_batch"));
 377: 
 378:         // Validate the database state inside this same transaction. If any replay table still
 379:         // contains rows, throw and rollback instead of reporting a false successful purge.
 380:         java.util.List<String> replayTables = java.util.List.of(
 381:                 "one_candle_continuation_grace_test", "defensive_risk_reduction_observation_test", "position_management_test", "wallet_execution_test", "wallet_position_test",
 382:                 "execution_opportunity_test", "trade_signal_test", "analysis_test_signal",
 383:                 "analysis_test_result", "analysis_test_run",
 384:                 "one_candle_continuation_grace_test_archive", "defensive_risk_reduction_observation_test_archive", "position_management_test_archive", "wallet_execution_test_archive",
 385:                 "wallet_position_test_archive", "execution_opportunity_test_archive",
 386:                 "trade_signal_test_archive", "analysis_test_signal_archive",
 387:                 "analysis_test_result_archive", "analysis_test_run_archive",
 388:                 "regression_test_archive_batch");
 389:         Map<String, Integer> remaining = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();
 390:         for (String table : replayTables) remaining.put(table, countRows(table));
 391:         java.util.List<String> nonEmpty = remaining.entrySet().stream()
 392:                 .filter(e -> e.getValue() != 0).map(Map.Entry::getKey).toList();
 393:         if (!nonEmpty.isEmpty()) {
 394:             throw new IllegalStateException("Delete Test Data validation failed; rows remain in: " + String.join(", ", nonEmpty));
 395:         }
 396: 
 397:         int provenAfter = countRows("proven_analyzed_trade");
 398:         int provenLegsAfter = countRows("proven_trade_leg_archive");
 399:         if (provenBefore != provenAfter || provenLegsBefore != provenLegsAfter) {
 400:             throw new IllegalStateException("Delete Test Data validation failed; Proven records changed unexpectedly.");
 401:         }
 402: 
 403:         // Reset only tables that own an AUTO_INCREMENT id. This is cosmetic and happens only
 404:         // after successful delete + validation; Proven ids are never reset.
 405:         java.util.List<String> autoIncrementTables = java.util.List.of(
 406:                 "one_candle_continuation_grace_test", "defensive_risk_reduction_observation_test", "wallet_execution_test", "wallet_position_test", "position_management_test",
 407:                 "execution_opportunity_test", "trade_signal_test", "analysis_test_signal",
 408:                 "analysis_test_result", "analysis_test_run", "regression_test_archive_batch");
 409:         for (String table : autoIncrementTables) jdbcTemplate.execute("ALTER TABLE " + table + " AUTO_INCREMENT = 1");
 410: 
 411:         return Map.of(
 412:                 "success", true,
 413:                 "message", "All replay/test data deleted and validated; Proven trades preserved.",
 414:                 "deleted", deleted,
 415:                 "remaining", remaining,
 416:                 "provenTradesPreserved", provenAfter,
 417:                 "provenTradeLegsPreserved", provenLegsAfter
 418:         );
 419:     }

 421:     private int countRows(String table) {
 422:         Integer count = jdbcTemplate.queryForObject("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM " + table, Integer.class);
 423:         return count == null ? 0 : count;
 424:     }

 459:     @Transactional(readOnly = true)
 460:     public List<Map<String, Object>> latestRuns() {
 461:         List<Map<String, Object>> runs = jdbcTemplate.queryForList("""
 462:                 SELECT r.id, r.test_name, r.symbol, r.start_time, r.end_time, r.status, r.progress_percent,
 463:                        r.current_step, r.heartbeat_at, r.started_at, r.completed_at, r.created_at,
 464:                        r.timing_total_ns,
 465:                        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wallet_position_test w WHERE w.test_run_id=r.id AND w.exit_time IS NOT NULL) AS closed_trade_count,
 466:                        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM proven_analyzed_trade p WHERE p.source_test_run_id=r.id) AS proven_trade_count
 467:                 FROM analysis_test_run r
 468:                 ORDER BY r.id DESC
 469:                 LIMIT 20
 470:                 """);
 471:         // FIX-087: heartbeat freshness is only a persistence signal; actual worker ownership is
 472:         // surfaced separately so a long healthy replay is not presented as resumable.
 473:         runs.forEach(run -> run.put("active_worker", worker.isActive(((Number) run.get("id")).longValue())));
 474:         return runs;
 475:     }

 507:     /**
 508:      * FIX-11S: one read-only chart payload for an entire Replay run. Replay executions are
 509:      * taken from the isolated wallet_execution_test rows; Production executions are only
 510:      * queried for the same symbol and requested Replay window. An empty Production result
 511:      * is a normal case and is deliberately returned as [] rather than null.
 512:      */
 513:     @Transactional(readOnly = true)
 514:     public Map<String, Object> allTradesChart(long runId, String interval) {
 515:         List<Map<String, Object>> runs = jdbcTemplate.queryForList("""
 516:                 SELECT id, symbol, start_time, end_time
 517:                 FROM analysis_test_run
 518:                 WHERE id = ?
 519:                 """, runId);
 520:         if (runs.isEmpty()) {
 521:             throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Replay run not found.");
 522:         }
 523: 
 524:         Map<String, Object> run = runs.get(0);
 525:         String symbol = String.valueOf(run.get("symbol")).trim().toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
 526:         Timestamp start = (Timestamp) run.get("start_time");
 527:         Timestamp end = (Timestamp) run.get("end_time");
 528:         String normalizedInterval = switch (interval == null ? "5m" : interval.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)) {
 529:             case "1m", "5m", "1h", "4h" -> interval.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
 530:             default -> "5m";
 531:         };
 532: 
 533:         List<Map<String, Object>> candles = candleReader(jdbcTemplate).queryForList("""
 534:                 SELECT open_time, open_price, high_price, low_price, close_price, volume
 535:                 FROM candle
 536:                 WHERE symbol=? AND interval_code=? AND closed=1 AND open_time BETWEEN ? AND ?
 537:                 ORDER BY open_time ASC
 538:                 """, symbol, normalizedInterval, start, end);
 539: 
 540:         List<Map<String, Object>> replayExecutions = jdbcTemplate.queryForList("""
 541:                 SELECT id, side, execution_time, execution_price, quantity, notional_usdt,
 542:                        position_percent, signal_interval, signal_decision, execution_source,
 543:                        execution_code, execution_reason, realized_pnl_usdt, realized_pnl_percent
 544:                 FROM wallet_execution_test
 545:                 WHERE test_run_id=? AND symbol=?
 546:                   AND execution_time BETWEEN ? AND ?
 547:                   AND UPPER(side) IN ('BUY','SELL')
 548:                 ORDER BY execution_time ASC, id ASC
 549:                 """, runId, symbol, start, end);
 550: 
 551:         Map<String, Object> result = new LinkedHashMap<>();
 552:         result.put("runId", runId);
 553:         result.put("symbol", symbol);
 554:         result.put("interval", normalizedInterval);
 555:         result.put("from", start);
 556:         result.put("to", end);
 557:         result.put("candles", candles);
 558:         result.put("replayExecutions", replayExecutions);
 559:         // FIX-156 / D47: the baseline Replay chart is deliberately
 560:         // Replay-owned. It never reads wallet_trade as a convenient overlay;
 561:         // any Production comparison belongs in an immutable, pre-extracted
 562:         // fixture and in the parity report, not in the execution UI query.
 563:         return result;
 564:     }

 597:     @Transactional
 598:     public Map<String, Object> markProvenSuccess(long runId, long tradeId) {
 599:         List<Map<String, Object>> rows = jdbcTemplate.queryForList("""
 600:                 SELECT id, test_run_id, symbol, entry_time, entry_price, exit_time, exit_price, exit_reason,
 601:                        realized_pnl_usdt, realized_pnl_percent, position_percent
 602:                 FROM wallet_position_test
 603:                 WHERE test_run_id = ? AND id = ? AND status = 'CLOSED'
 604:                 """, runId, tradeId);
 605:         if (rows.isEmpty()) throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Shadow trade not found.");
 606:         Map<String, Object> t = rows.get(0);
 607:         jdbcTemplate.update("""
 608:                 INSERT INTO proven_analyzed_trade
 609:                     (source_test_run_id, source_trade_id, symbol, entry_time, entry_price, exit_time, exit_price,
 610:                      exit_reason, realized_pnl_usdt, realized_pnl_percent, position_percent)
 611:                 VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
 612:                 ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE symbol=VALUES(symbol), entry_time=VALUES(entry_time), entry_price=VALUES(entry_price),
 613:                     exit_time=VALUES(exit_time), exit_price=VALUES(exit_price), exit_reason=VALUES(exit_reason),
 614:                     realized_pnl_usdt=VALUES(realized_pnl_usdt), realized_pnl_percent=VALUES(realized_pnl_percent),
 615:                     position_percent=VALUES(position_percent), marked_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
 616:                 """,
 617:                 runId, tradeId, t.get("symbol"), t.get("entry_time"), t.get("entry_price"), t.get("exit_time"),
 618:                 t.get("exit_price"), t.get("exit_reason"), t.get("realized_pnl_usdt"), t.get("realized_pnl_percent"),
 619:                 t.get("position_percent"));
 620:         // FIX-122: snapshot before a later Replay purge can remove/reuse this run identity.
 621:         Long provenId=jdbcTemplate.queryForObject("SELECT id FROM proven_analyzed_trade WHERE source_test_run_id=? AND source_trade_id=?",Long.class,runId,tradeId);
 622:         com.crypto.execution.service.Fix122ProvenSnapshot.capture(jdbcTemplate,provenId,runId,(String)t.get("symbol"),
 623:                 ((Timestamp)t.get("entry_time")).toInstant().minusSeconds(1800),((Timestamp)t.get("exit_time")).toInstant());
 624:         return Map.of("saved", true, "runId", runId, "tradeId", tradeId);
 625:     }

 649:     /**
 650:      * Archive only one reviewed execution leg. This is intentionally separate from
 651:      * regression-run archiving: a reviewer can preserve the BUY or SELL point on its
 652:      * own without freezing/copying the complete test run. Clear Data still keeps the
 653:      * existing full-run safety archive so replay diagnostics remain recoverable.
 654:      */
 655:     @Transactional
 656:     public Map<String, Object> archiveProvenTradeLeg(long provenTradeId, String requestedSide) {
 657:         String side = requestedSide == null ? "" : requestedSide.trim().toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
 658:         if (!side.equals("BUY") && !side.equals("SELL")) {
 659:             throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "Archive side must be BUY or SELL.");
 660:         }
 661:         List<Map<String, Object>> rows = jdbcTemplate.queryForList("""
 662:                 SELECT id, source_test_run_id, source_trade_id, symbol, entry_time, entry_price, exit_time, exit_price,
 663:                        exit_reason, realized_pnl_usdt, realized_pnl_percent
 664:                 FROM proven_analyzed_trade
 665:                 WHERE id=?
 666:                 """, provenTradeId);
 667:         if (rows.isEmpty()) throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Proven trade not found.");
 668:         Map<String, Object> trade = rows.get(0);
 669:         Object time = side.equals("BUY") ? trade.get("entry_time") : trade.get("exit_time");
 670:         Object price = side.equals("BUY") ? trade.get("entry_price") : trade.get("exit_price");
 671:         if (time == null || price == null) {
 672:             throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, side + " leg is not available for this proven trade.");
 673:         }
 674:         jdbcTemplate.update("""
 675:                 INSERT INTO proven_trade_leg_archive
 676:                     (proven_trade_id, source_test_run_id, source_trade_id, symbol, side, execution_time, execution_price,
 677:                      exit_reason, realized_pnl_usdt, realized_pnl_percent)
 678:                 VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
 679:                 ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE execution_time=VALUES(execution_time), execution_price=VALUES(execution_price),
 680:                     exit_reason=VALUES(exit_reason), realized_pnl_usdt=VALUES(realized_pnl_usdt),
 681:                     realized_pnl_percent=VALUES(realized_pnl_percent), archived_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
 682:                 """, provenTradeId, trade.get("source_test_run_id"), trade.get("source_trade_id"), trade.get("symbol"),
 683:                 side, time, price, side.equals("SELL") ? trade.get("exit_reason") : null,
 684:                 side.equals("SELL") ? trade.get("realized_pnl_usdt") : null,
 685:                 side.equals("SELL") ? trade.get("realized_pnl_percent") : null);
 686:         return Map.of("archived", true, "provenTradeId", provenTradeId, "side", side);
 687:     }

 702:     @Transactional(readOnly = true)
 703:     public Map<String, Object> provenTradeChart(String symbol, String interval) {
 704:         String normalized = symbol == null ? "" : symbol.trim().toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
 705:         String normalizedInterval = switch (interval == null ? "5m" : interval.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)) {
 706:             case "1m", "5m", "1h", "4h" -> interval.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
 707:             default -> "5m";
 708:         };
 709:         List<Map<String, Object>> trades = jdbcTemplate.queryForList("""
 710:                 SELECT id, source_test_run_id, source_trade_id, symbol, entry_time, entry_price, exit_time, exit_price,
 711:                        exit_reason, realized_pnl_usdt, realized_pnl_percent, position_percent, marked_at
 712:                 FROM proven_analyzed_trade
 713:                 WHERE symbol = ?
 714:                 ORDER BY entry_time ASC
 715:                 LIMIT 250
 716:                 """, normalized);
 717:         java.util.LinkedHashMap<String, Map<String, Object>> candles = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();
 718:         for (Map<String, Object> trade : trades) {
 719:             Timestamp entry = (Timestamp) trade.get("entry_time");
 720:             Timestamp exit = (Timestamp) trade.get("exit_time");
 721:             if (entry == null) continue;
 722:             // Proven-analysis charts intentionally use real historical candles with a wide context window.
 723:             // Keep seven hours before the BUY and seven hours after the SELL so manual review can
 724:             // detect late entries and premature exits instead of judging only the replay window.
 725:             Instant from = entry.toInstant().minus(java.time.Duration.ofHours(7));
 726:             Instant to = (exit == null ? entry.toInstant() : exit.toInstant()).plus(java.time.Duration.ofHours(7));
 727:             List<Map<String, Object>> segment = candleReader(jdbcTemplate).queryForList("""
 728:                     SELECT open_time, open_price, high_price, low_price, close_price, volume
 729:                     FROM candle
 730:                     WHERE symbol=? AND interval_code=? AND closed=1 AND open_time BETWEEN ? AND ?
 731:                     ORDER BY open_time ASC
 732:                     """, normalized, normalizedInterval, Timestamp.from(from), Timestamp.from(to));
 733:             for (Map<String, Object> c : segment) candles.put(String.valueOf(c.get("open_time")), c);
 734:         }
 735:         return Map.of("symbol", normalized, "interval", normalizedInterval, "trades", trades,
 736:                 "candles", new java.util.ArrayList<>(candles.values()));
 737:     }
 738: 
 739:     @Transactional(readOnly = true)
 740:     public List<Map<String, Object>> opportunities(long runId) {
 741:         return jdbcTemplate.queryForList("""
 742:                 SELECT generated_at, replay_stage, current_original_decision, current_final_decision,
 743:                        five_minute_decision, one_hour_decision, evidence_count, buy_count, watch_count,
 744:                        neutral_count, bearish_count, evidence_score, opportunity_health,
 745:                        recommended_position_percent, decision_code, decision_explanation
 746:                 FROM execution_opportunity_test
 747:                 WHERE test_run_id = ? AND replay_stage IS NOT NULL
 748:                 ORDER BY generated_at ASC
 749:                 LIMIT 3000
 750:                 """, runId);
 751:     }
 752: 
 753:     @Transactional(readOnly = true)
 754:     public Map<String, Object> replayTradeChart(String symbol, String interval, Instant from, Instant to) {
 755:         String normalized = symbol == null ? "" : symbol.trim().toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
 756:         String normalizedInterval = switch (interval == null ? "5m" : interval.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)) {
 757:             case "1m", "5m", "1h", "4h" -> interval.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
 758:             default -> "5m";
 759:         };
 760:         if (normalized.isBlank() || from == null || to == null || !to.isAfter(from)) {
 761:             throw new IllegalArgumentException("Symbol and a valid chart window are required.");
 762:         }
 763:         List<Map<String, Object>> candles = candleReader(jdbcTemplate).queryForList("""
 764:                 SELECT open_time, open_price, high_price, low_price, close_price, volume
 765:                 FROM candle
 766:                 WHERE symbol=? AND interval_code=? AND closed=1 AND open_time BETWEEN ? AND ?
 767:                 ORDER BY open_time ASC
 768:                 """, normalized, normalizedInterval, Timestamp.from(from), Timestamp.from(to));
 769:         return Map.of("symbol", normalized, "interval", normalizedInterval, "candles", candles);
 770:     }
 771: 
 772: }

===== src/main/java/com/crypto/shared/CandleInputAudit.java =====
   1: package com.crypto.shared;
   2: 
   3: import com.crypto.domain.Candle;
   4: import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
   5: import java.util.*;
   6: import org.springframework.transaction.PlatformTransactionManager;
   7: import org.springframework.transaction.TransactionDefinition;
   8: import org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionTemplate;
   9: import org.springframework.jdbc.support.JdbcTransactionManager;
  10: import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
  11: 
  12: /** Approved current-committed input contract. Hashes detect corrected inputs;
  13:  * they do not reconstruct a previous candle version or claim bitemporal Replay. */
  14: public final class CandleInputAudit implements AutoCloseable {
  15:     private static final org.slf4j.Logger log=org.slf4j.LoggerFactory.getLogger(CandleInputAudit.class);
  16:     private static final ThreadLocal<CandleInputAudit> CURRENT = new ThreadLocal<>();
  17:     private final CandleInputAudit previous;
  18:     private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
  19:     private final String context;
  20:     private final TransactionTemplate writes;
  21:     private int index;
  22:     private CandleInputAudit(JdbcTemplate jdbc, PlatformTransactionManager manager, String context) {
  23:         this.jdbc=jdbc; this.context=context;
  24:         writes=new TransactionTemplate(manager);
  25:         // FIX-136: candle validation enters a local read-only JPA transaction.
  26:         // Use the SAME transaction manager to suspend its EntityManager/connection;
  27:         // an inner REQUIRED transaction cannot make that connection writable.
  28:         writes.setPropagationBehavior(TransactionDefinition.PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW);
  29:         writes.setReadOnly(false);
  30:         writes.setTimeout(5);
  31:         previous=CURRENT.get(); CURRENT.set(this);
  32:     }
  33:     public static CandleInputAudit open(JdbcTemplate jdbc, PlatformTransactionManager manager, String context) {
  34:         return new CandleInputAudit(jdbc,manager,context);
  35:     }
  36:     /** Standalone JDBC callers/tests only. Managed JPA callers must pass their manager. */
  37:     public static CandleInputAudit open(JdbcTemplate jdbc,String context) {
  38:         return open(jdbc,new JdbcTransactionManager(Objects.requireNonNull(jdbc.getDataSource())),context);
  39:     }
  40:     public static void capture(String query,List<Candle> rows) {
  41:         CandleInputAudit audit=CURRENT.get(); if(audit==null)return;
  42:         try {
  43:             var hash=java.security.MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256");
  44:             for(Candle c:rows) hash.update((c.getSymbol()+"|"+c.getIntervalCode()+"|"+c.getOpenTime()+"|"+c.getCloseTime()+"|"+
  45:                 c.getOpenPrice()+"|"+c.getHighPrice()+"|"+c.getLowPrice()+"|"+c.getClosePrice()+"|"+c.getVolume()+"|"+
  46:                 c.getQuoteAssetVolume()+"|"+c.getNumberOfTrades()+"|"+c.getTakerBuyBaseVolume()+"|"+c.getTakerBuyQuoteVolume()+"|"+c.isClosed()+"\n").getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
  47:             audit.writes.executeWithoutResult(tx -> audit.jdbc.update("INSERT INTO shared_candle_input_audit(context_key,read_index,input_hash,row_count,query_text) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)",
  48:                 audit.context,++audit.index,HexFormat.of().formatHex(hash.digest()),rows.size(),query.substring(0,Math.min(1000,query.length()))));
  49:         } catch(RuntimeException failure) {
  50:             log.error("[FIX-136][AUDIT_WRITE_FAILED] context={}, readIndex={}; analysis must not continue without input evidence",
  51:                     audit.context,audit.index,failure);
  52:             throw failure;
  53:         } catch(java.security.NoSuchAlgorithmException e) { throw new IllegalStateException(e); }
  54:     }
  55:     @Override public void close() { if(previous==null) CURRENT.remove(); else CURRENT.set(previous); }
  56: }

 169:     private int write(String symbol,String intervalCode,Instant openTime,Instant closeTime,
 170:         BigDecimal openPrice,BigDecimal highPrice,BigDecimal lowPrice,BigDecimal closePrice,
 171:         BigDecimal volume,BigDecimal quoteAssetVolume,Long numberOfTrades,BigDecimal takerBuyBaseVolume,
 172:         BigDecimal takerBuyQuoteVolume,boolean closed,String provenance,String token) {
 173:         String duplicateClause = "BACKFILL".equals(provenance) ? """

 185:                 taker_buy_base_volume=IF(closed=1,taker_buy_base_volume,VALUES(taker_buy_base_volume)),
 186:                 taker_buy_quote_volume=IF(closed=1,taker_buy_quote_volume,VALUES(taker_buy_quote_volume)),
 187:                 updated_at=IF(closed=1,updated_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)),
 188:                 closed=GREATEST(closed,VALUES(closed))
 189:             """ : """
 190:             ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
 191:                 close_time=IF(closed=1,close_time,VALUES(close_time)),
 192:                 open_price=IF(closed=1,open_price,VALUES(open_price)),
 193:                 high_price=IF(closed=1,high_price,VALUES(high_price)),
 194:                 low_price=IF(closed=1,low_price,VALUES(low_price)),
 195:                 close_price=IF(closed=1,close_price,VALUES(close_price)),
 196:                 volume=IF(closed=1,volume,VALUES(volume)),

  20: @Service

  44:         return replay.active() ? replay.stopBoundary(symbol, at) : store.latest(symbol, at);

  48:     public ExecutionDecision evaluate(TradeSignal signal, int allocation, Supplier<ExecutionDecision> action) {
  49:         if (allocation>0 || signal==null || signal.getGeneratedAt()==null || !enabled()) return action.get();
  50:         return scoped(signal, () -> new SetupWakeupEvaluation(signal, action.get())).decision();
  51:     }
  52: 
  53:     public SetupWakeupEvaluation wakeup(TradeSignal trigger, int allocation, Supplier<SetupWakeupEvaluation> action) {
  54:         if (allocation>0 || trigger==null || trigger.getGeneratedAt()==null || !enabled()) return action.get();
  55:         return scoped(trigger, action);
  56:     }
  57: 
  58:     private SetupWakeupEvaluation scoped(TradeSignal trigger, Supplier<SetupWakeupEvaluation> action) {
  59:         Context previous=active.get();
  60:         Context c=new Context(trigger, now(), replay.active()?replay.runId():null);
  61:         active.set(c);
  62:         try {
  63:             try { c.boundary=resolve(trigger.getSymbol(), c.at); }
  64:             catch (RuntimeException error) {
  65:                 log.warn("[FIX-122] BOUNDARY_UNAVAILABLE symbol={} signalId={}", trigger.getSymbol(), trigger.getId(), error);
  66:                 c.status="BOUNDARY_UNAVAILABLE";
  67:                 ExecutionDecision d=ExecutionDecision.reject("FIX122_BOUNDARY_UNAVAILABLE",
  68:                         "Stop history could not be checked. Entry deferred to the next normal evaluation.");
  69:                 audit(c,d,"EVALUATION");
  70:                 return new SetupWakeupEvaluation(trigger,d);
  71:             }
  72:             SetupWakeupEvaluation result;
  73:             if ("1m".equals(trigger.getInterval()) && !eligible(trigger,"CURRENT_SIGNAL")) {
  74:                 result=new SetupWakeupEvaluation(trigger, ExecutionDecision.reject("FIX122_CURRENT_CANDLE_STALE",
  75:                         "Current entry candle is not eligible after the completed stop-loss."));
  76:             } else {
  77:                 try { result=action.get(); }
  78:                 catch (StaleCurrent ignored) {
  79:                     result=new SetupWakeupEvaluation(c.current,ExecutionDecision.reject("FIX122_CURRENT_CANDLE_STALE",
  80:                             "Wake-up timing candle is not eligible after the completed stop-loss."));
  81:                 }
  82:             }
  83:             if (result!=null && result.decision()!=null) {
  84:                 result=new SetupWakeupEvaluation(result.executionSignal(), result.decision()
  85:                         .withStopBoundary(new StopLossEvidencePolicy.Stamp(c.boundary)));
  86:             }
  87:             audit(c,result==null?null:result.decision(),"EVALUATION");
  88:             return result==null?SetupWakeupEvaluation.none():result;
  89:         } finally {
  90:             if(previous==null) active.remove(); else active.set(previous);
  91:         }
  92:     }
  93: 
  94:     public void requireCurrent(TradeSignal signal) {
  95:         if(active.get()!=null) active.get().current=signal;
  96:         if(!eligible(signal,"CURRENT_SIGNAL")) throw new StaleCurrent();
  97:     }

  99:     public boolean eligible(TradeSignal signal, String purpose) {
 100:         Context c=active.get();
 101:         if(c==null || c.boundary==null) return true;
 102:         String reason=signal==null?"LINEAGE_UNRESOLVED":StopLossEvidencePolicy.exclusion(
 103:                 signal.getInterval(),signal.getCandleOpenTime(),signal.getGeneratedAt(),c.at,c.boundary);
 104:         if(reason==null) return true;
 105:         Map<String,Object> item=new LinkedHashMap<>();
 106:         item.put("purpose",purpose); item.put("reason",reason);
 107:         if(signal!=null) {
 108:             item.put("signalId",signal.getId()); item.put("interval",signal.getInterval());
 109:             item.put("candleOpenTime",String.valueOf(signal.getCandleOpenTime()));
 110:             item.put("decision",String.valueOf(signal.getDecision()));
 111:         }
 112:         if(!c.excluded.contains(item)) c.excluded.add(item);
 113:         return false;
 114:     }
 115: 
 116:     /** Read again at execution-price approval. A newly committed stop invalidates the
 117:      * old approval. This is not a repair of the separate wallet transaction race.
 118:      */
 119:     public ExecutionDecision recheck(TradeSignal signal, ExecutionDecision approved) {
 120:         if(approved==null || !approved.allowed() || approved.stopBoundary()==null || !enabled()) return approved;
 121:         Context c=new Context(signal,now(),replay.active()?replay.runId():null);
 122:         ExecutionDecision result=approved;
 123:         try {
 124:             c.boundary=resolve(signal.getSymbol(),c.at);
 125:             if(!Objects.equals(approved.stopBoundary().boundary(),c.boundary)) {
 126:                 c.status="BOUNDARY_CHANGED";
 127:                 result=ExecutionDecision.reject("FIX122_BOUNDARY_CHANGED",
 128:                         "A stop-loss boundary changed after qualification. Wait for a fresh evaluation.", approved.evidence());
 129:             }
 130:         } catch(RuntimeException error) {
 131:             c.status="BOUNDARY_UNAVAILABLE";
 132:             result=ExecutionDecision.reject("FIX122_BOUNDARY_UNAVAILABLE",
 133:                     "Stop history unavailable at price revalidation. Entry deferred.",approved.evidence());
 134:             log.warn("[FIX-122] RECHECK_UNAVAILABLE symbol={}",signal.getSymbol(),error);
 135:         }
 136:         audit(c,result,"PRICE_RECHECK");
 137:         return result;
 138:     }
 139: 
 140:     private void audit(Context c,ExecutionDecision d,String stage) {
 141:         Map<String,Object> p=new LinkedHashMap<>();
 142:         p.put("revision","FIX-122"); p.put("source",c.runId==null?"PRODUCTION":"REPLAY");
 143:         p.put("status",c.status!=null?c.status:c.boundary==null?"NOT_APPLICABLE":
 144:                 c.excluded.isEmpty()?"APPLIED_NO_EXCLUSIONS":"APPLIED_EXCLUSIONS");
 145:         p.put("signalId",c.current.getId()); p.put("candleOpenTime",String.valueOf(c.current.getCandleOpenTime()));
 146:         p.put("triggerSignalId",c.trigger.getId());
 147:         p.put("stopExecutionId",c.boundary==null?null:c.boundary.executionId());
 148:         p.put("stopAt",c.boundary==null?null:c.boundary.executedAt().toString());
 149:         p.put("excluded",c.excluded);
 150:         p.put("allowed",d!=null&&d.allowed()); p.put("route",d==null?null:d.source());
 151:         p.put("code",d==null?"NO_WAKEUP":d.code()); p.put("explanation",d==null?null:d.explanation());
 152:         if(d!=null && d.evidence()!=null) {
 153:             p.put("buyCount",d.evidence().buyCount()); p.put("watchCount",d.evidence().watchCount());
 154:             p.put("evidenceScore",d.evidence().evidenceScore()); p.put("health",d.evidence().opportunityHealth());
 155:             p.put("positionPercent",d.positionPercent());
 156:         }
 157:         try { store.append(c.runId,c.trigger.getSymbol(),c.current.getId(),c.at,stage,mapper.writeValueAsString(p)); }
 158:         catch(Exception error) { log.error("[FIX-122] DIAGNOSTIC_PERSIST_FAILED symbol={} signalId={}",
 159:                 c.trigger.getSymbol(),c.current.getId(),error); }
 160:         if(c.boundary!=null || c.status!=null) log.info(
 161:                 "[FIX-122] {} symbol={} signalId={} stop={} excluded={} code={} allowed={}",stage,
 162:                 c.trigger.getSymbol(),c.current.getId(),c.boundary,c.excluded.size(),p.get("code"),p.get("allowed"));
 163:     }

 171:     }
