   1: package com.crypto.execution.service;
   2: 
   3: import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
   4: import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
   5: import org.springframework.transaction.PlatformTransactionManager;
   6: import org.springframework.transaction.TransactionDefinition;
   7: import org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionTemplate;
   8: import javax.sql.DataSource;
   9: import java.sql.Timestamp;
  10: import java.time.Instant;
  11: import java.util.List;
  12: import java.util.Map;
  13: 
  14: /** FIX-122: bounded, non-locking committed ledger reads; no managed-position row locks.
  15:  * STOP_LOSS is the terminal reason written by executeSignalLinkedExit. The distinct
  16:  * POSITION_STOP_LOSS and partial-harvest reasons are deliberately not included.
  17:  */
  18: @Service
  19: public class StopLossEvidenceStore {
  20:     private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
  21:     private final TransactionTemplate read;
  22:     private final TransactionTemplate write;
  23: 
  24:     public StopLossEvidenceStore(DataSource dataSource, PlatformTransactionManager manager) {
  25:         jdbc = new JdbcTemplate(dataSource);
  26:         jdbc.setQueryTimeout(2);
  27:         read = new TransactionTemplate(manager);
  28:         read.setPropagationBehavior(TransactionDefinition.PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW);
  29:         read.setIsolationLevel(TransactionDefinition.ISOLATION_READ_COMMITTED);
  30:         read.setReadOnly(true);
  31:         read.setTimeout(2);
  32:         write = new TransactionTemplate(manager);
  33:         write.setPropagationBehavior(TransactionDefinition.PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW);
  34:         write.setTimeout(2);
  35:     }
  36: 
  37:     public StopLossEvidencePolicy.Boundary latest(String symbol, Instant asOf) {
  38:         return read.execute(status -> jdbc.query("""
  39:                 SELECT id, executed_at FROM wallet_trade
  40:                 WHERE symbol=? AND status='EXECUTED' AND side='SELL'
  41:                   AND execution_reason='STOP_LOSS' AND executed_at<=?
  42:                 ORDER BY executed_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
  43:                 """, (rs, row) -> new StopLossEvidencePolicy.Boundary(rs.getLong(1),
  44:                 rs.getTimestamp(2).toInstant()), symbol, Timestamp.from(asOf))
  45:                 .stream().findFirst().orElse(null));
  46:     }
  47: 
  48:     public void append(Long runId, String symbol, Long signalId, Instant at, String stage, String payload) {
  49:         // Separate audit transaction survives a caller rollback; it records an evaluation,
  50:         // never asserts that a BUY/SELL actually executed. No FK to wallet rows is acquired.
  51:         write.executeWithoutResult(status -> jdbc.update("""
  52:                 INSERT INTO fix122_evaluation(test_run_id,symbol,signal_id,evaluated_at,stage,payload)
  53:                 VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)
  54:                 """, runId, symbol, signalId, Timestamp.from(at), stage, payload));
  55:     }
  56: 
  57:     public List<Map<String,Object>> replayDetails(long runId) {
  58:         return jdbc.queryForList("SELECT * FROM fix122_evaluation WHERE test_run_id=? ORDER BY id", runId);
  59:     }
  60: 
  61:     public List<Map<String,Object>> productionDetails(String symbol, Instant from, Instant to) {
  62:         return jdbc.queryForList("""
  63:                 SELECT * FROM fix122_evaluation WHERE test_run_id IS NULL AND symbol=?
  64:                 AND evaluated_at>=? AND evaluated_at<=? ORDER BY id
  65:                 """, symbol, Timestamp.from(from), Timestamp.from(to));
  66:     }
  67: }

 592:         }
 593:         BigDecimal minimumProfitableExit = p.entryPrice().multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(1.0005));
 594:         if (authoritativePrice && updated.profitLockState() == ProfitLockState.TP_EXTENSION_REBASE
 595:                 && price.compareTo(minimumProfitableExit) < 0) {
 596:             String floorReason = "TP-extension rebase safety floor was breached at " + minimumProfitableExit + ". "
 597:                     + profitLockConfigText();
 598:             log.info("[FIX-118][REPLAY][SIGNAL_REBASE_HARD_FLOOR] runId={}, positionId={}, signalId={}, symbol={}, generatedAt={}, price={}, floor={}",
 599:                     runId, updated.positionId(), s.getId(), s.getSymbol(), s.getGeneratedAt(), price, minimumProfitableExit);
 600:             persistManagement(runId, s, "PROFIT_LOCK_HARD_EXIT", p.takeProfit(), p.takeProfit(), updated, floorReason);
 601:             return new ExitDecision(true, "PROFIT_LOCK_HARD_EXIT", floorReason);
 602:         }
 603:         if (authoritativePrice && updated.profitLockState() == ProfitLockState.ACTIVE && updated.profitLockPrice() != null
 604:                 && price.compareTo(updated.profitLockPrice()) <= 0) {
 605:             log.info("[FIX-118][REPLAY][SIGNAL_TRIGGER] runId={}, positionId={}, signalId={}, symbol={}, generatedAt={}, price={}, lock={}, target={}",
 606:                     runId, updated.positionId(), s.getId(), s.getSymbol(), s.getGeneratedAt(), price,
 607:                     updated.profitLockPrice(), updated.takeProfit());
 608:             if (price.compareTo(minimumProfitableExit) < 0) {
 609:                 String floorReason = "Profit-lock hard floor was breached; protected profit can no longer be preserved. "
 610:                         + profitLockConfigText();
 611:                 persistManagement(runId, s, "PROFIT_LOCK_HARD_EXIT", p.takeProfit(), p.takeProfit(), updated, floorReason);
 612:                 return new ExitDecision(true, "PROFIT_LOCK_HARD_EXIT", floorReason);
 613:             }
 614:             PositionExitPolicy.Evaluation lockDecision = exitPolicy.evaluateProfitLockBreach(
 615:                     oneMinute != null ? oneMinute : s, five, one);
 616:             if (!lockDecision.exit()) {
 617:                 String holdReason = lockDecision.explanation() + " " + profitLockConfigText();
 618:                 persistManagement(runId, s, "PROFIT_LOCK_HOLD", p.takeProfit(), p.takeProfit(), updated, holdReason);
 619:                 return ExitDecision.hold();
 620:             }
 621:             String lockReason = "Price retraced to the protected profit level after a profitable advance. "
 622:                     + lockDecision.explanation() + " " + profitLockConfigText();
 623:             persistManagement(runId, s, "PROFIT_LOCK_EXIT", p.takeProfit(), p.takeProfit(), updated, lockReason);
 624:             return new ExitDecision(true, lockDecision.code(), lockReason);
 625:         }
 626:         // Production has two SELL authorities: the live HTF PositionExitPolicy and the
 627:         // 1m signal TradeExecutionValidationService. Replay executes both shared production
 628:         // policies in the same order instead of carrying a test-only SELL rule.
 629:         PositionExitPolicy.Evaluation normalExit = exitPolicy.evaluateNormalExit(
 630:                 oneMinute != null ? oneMinute : s, five, one);
 631:         if (normalExit.exit()) {
 632:             return new ExitDecision(true, normalExit.code(), normalExit.explanation());
 633:         }
 634:         if ("1m".equals(s.getInterval()) && bearish(s.getDecision())) {
 635:             ReplaySellValidationPolicy.Result validatedSell = replaySellValidationPolicy.validate(s, five, one);
 636:             if (validatedSell.allowed()) {
 637:                 return new ExitDecision(true, validatedSell.code(), validatedSell.explanation());
 638:             }
 639:         }
 640:         return ExitDecision.hold();
 641:     }
 642: 
 643:     private FallbackNearTpEvaluation evaluateNearTpAtSignalFallback(long runId, ShadowPosition current,
 644:                                                                     TradeSignal signal, TradeSignal oneMinute,
 645:                                                                     TradeSignal fiveMinute) {
 646:         NearTpFailureProtectionPolicy.State state = new NearTpFailureProtectionPolicy.State(
 647:                 current.nearTpState(), current.nearTpBestPrice(), current.nearTpBearishStreak(),
 648:                 current.nearTpLastOneMinuteSignalId(), current.nearTpHarvestUsed());
 649:         NearTpFailureProtectionPolicy.Evaluation evaluation = nearTpFailureProtectionPolicy.evaluate(
 650:                 state, current.entryPrice(), current.takeProfit(), signal.getLatestPrice(), signal.getGeneratedAt(),
 651:                 oneMinute, fiveMinute);
 652:         ShadowPosition updated = current.withNearTp(evaluation.state());
 653:         if (!updated.sameNearTp(current)) persistNearTpState(updated);
 654:         if (evaluation.transition()) {
 655:             log.info("FIX-11T Replay fallback Near-TP: runId={}, positionId={}, symbol={}, code={}, state={}, price={}, givebackPct={}, bearish1mStreak={}, detail={}",
 656:                     runId, updated.positionId(), signal.getSymbol(), evaluation.code(), updated.nearTpState(),
 657:                     signal.getLatestPrice(), evaluation.givebackPercent(), updated.nearTpBearishStreak(), evaluation.explanation());
 658:         }
 659:         if (!evaluation.harvestEligible()) return new FallbackNearTpEvaluation(updated, BigDecimal.ZERO, BigDecimal.ZERO);
 660: 
 661:         BigDecimal soldQty = updated.quantity().multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(0.50), MC);
 662:             ReplayMinimumExecutionPolicy.Evaluation minimumCheck =
 663:                     replayMinimumExecutionPolicy.evaluate(profile().minimumExecutableNotionalUsdt(), soldQty, signal.getLatestPrice());
 664:         if (!minimumCheck.executable()) {
 665:             updated = updated.withNearTp(new NearTpFailureProtectionPolicy.State(
 666:                     NearTpState.NEAR_TP_REJECTION_DETECTED, updated.nearTpBestPrice(),
 667:                     0, updated.nearTpLastOneMinuteSignalId(), false));
 668:             persistNearTpState(updated);
 669:             log.info("FIX-11T Replay fallback NEAR_TP_HARVEST_SKIPPED: runId={}, positionId={}, symbol={}, reason={}, requestedQty={}, requestedNotional={}, binanceMinimum={}; existing position management continues",
 670:                     runId, updated.positionId(), signal.getSymbol(), minimumCheck.code(), soldQty,
 671:                     minimumCheck.requestedNotional(), minimumCheck.minimumNotional());
 672:             return new FallbackNearTpEvaluation(updated, BigDecimal.ZERO, BigDecimal.ZERO);
 673:         }
 674:         BigDecimal proceeds = soldQty.multiply(signal.getLatestPrice(), MC);
 675:         BigDecimal soldCost = updated.entryPrice().multiply(soldQty, MC);
 676:         BigDecimal pnl = proceeds.subtract(soldCost, MC);
 677:         BigDecimal pnlPct = soldCost.signum() == 0 ? BigDecimal.ZERO : pnl.divide(soldCost, 8, RoundingMode.HALF_UP)
 678:                 .multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(100));
 679:         updated = updated.withPartialHarvest(soldQty, soldCost, pnl);
 680:         persistNearTpPartialHarvestAtSignal(runId, signal, updated, soldQty, proceeds, pnl, pnlPct, evaluation.explanation());
 681:         log.info("FIX-11T Replay fallback NEAR_TP_PARTIAL_HARVESTED: runId={}, positionId={}, symbol={}, soldQty={}, remainingQty={}, price={}, partialPnl={}",
 682:                 runId, updated.positionId(), signal.getSymbol(), soldQty, updated.quantity(), signal.getLatestPrice(), pnl);
 683:         return new FallbackNearTpEvaluation(updated, proceeds, pnl);
 684:     }

 686:     private ShadowPosition updateProfitLock(ShadowPosition p, TradeSignal s) {
 687:         if (s.getLatestPrice() == null || !priceAuthorityPolicy.canUseSignalPrice(s, p.entryTime())) return p;
 688:         ShadowPosition n = profitLockState(p, s.getLatestPrice());
 689:         if (!equalsNullable(p.highest(), n.highest()) || p.profitLockActive() != n.profitLockActive()
 690:                 || !equalsNullable(p.profitLockPrice(), n.profitLockPrice())
 691:                 || p.profitLockState() != n.profitLockState()
 692:                 || !java.util.Objects.equals(p.profitLockRebaseStartedAt(), n.profitLockRebaseStartedAt())) {
 693:             jdbcTemplate.update("UPDATE wallet_position_test SET highest_price_usdt=?, profit_lock_active=?, profit_lock_price_usdt=?, profit_lock_state=?, profit_lock_rebase_started_at=? WHERE id=?",
 694:                     n.highest(), n.profitLockActive(), n.profitLockPrice(), n.profitLockState().name(),
 695:                     n.profitLockRebaseStartedAt() == null ? null : Timestamp.from(n.profitLockRebaseStartedAt()), p.positionId());
 696:         }
 697:         return n;
 698:     }
 699: 
 700:     private ShadowPosition profitLockState(ShadowPosition p, BigDecimal price) {
 701:         ReplayPolicyProfile settings = profile();
 702:         BigDecimal activation = settings.profitLockActivationPercent();
 703:         BigDecimal highest = p.highest() == null ? price : p.highest().max(price);
 704:         BigDecimal progress = progressPercent(p.entryPrice(), p.takeProfit(), highest);
 705: 
 706:         if (p.profitLockState() == ProfitLockState.TP_EXTENSION_REBASE
 707:                 && progress.compareTo(activation) < 0) {
 708:             // Replay parity with Production FIX-118: preserve the historical lock/legacy flag,
 709:             // but keep it non-executable until the new TP geometry earns activation again.
 710:             return p.withLock(highest, true, p.profitLockPrice(), ProfitLockState.TP_EXTENSION_REBASE,
 711:                     p.profitLockRebaseStartedAt());
 712:         }
 713: 
 714:         // FIX-118 parity: when REBASE earns activation, rebuild the lock from the current
 715:         // TP geometry instead of retaining the superseded pre-extension lock.
 716:         boolean freshGeometryActivation = p.profitLockState() == ProfitLockState.TP_EXTENSION_REBASE;
 717:         ProfitLockPolicy.State state = profitLockPolicy.evaluate(
 718:                 p.entryPrice(), p.takeProfit(), price, highest,
 719:                 freshGeometryActivation ? false : (p.profitLockState() == ProfitLockState.ACTIVE || p.profitLockActive()),
 720:                 freshGeometryActivation ? null : p.profitLockPrice(),
 721:                 settings.dynamicProfitLockEnabled(), activation,
 722:                 settings.profitLockInitialPercent(), settings.profitLockTrailStepPercent());
 723:         ProfitLockState nextState = state.active() ? ProfitLockState.ACTIVE : ProfitLockState.INACTIVE;
 724:         return p.withLock(state.highestPrice(), state.active(), state.lockPrice(), nextState, null);
 725:     }
 726: 
 727:     private ShadowPosition rebaseForExtendedTarget(ShadowPosition p, BigDecimal newTarget, BigDecimal extensionPrice, Instant at) {
 728:         if (p == null || newTarget == null) return p;
 729:         BigDecimal oldTarget = p.takeProfit();
 730:         BigDecimal oldLock = p.profitLockPrice();
 731:         BigDecimal activation = profile().profitLockActivationPercent();
 732:         BigDecimal extensionHighest = p.highest() == null ? p.entryPrice() : p.highest();
 733:         if (extensionPrice != null && extensionPrice.compareTo(extensionHighest) > 0) extensionHighest = extensionPrice;
 734:         ShadowPosition withExtensionHigh = p.withLock(extensionHighest, p.profitLockActive(), p.profitLockPrice(),
 735:                 p.profitLockState(), p.profitLockRebaseStartedAt());
 736:         BigDecimal progress = progressPercent(p.entryPrice(), newTarget, extensionHighest);
 737:         if (p.profitLockState() == ProfitLockState.ACTIVE) {
 738:             if (progress.compareTo(activation) < 0) {
 739:                 ShadowPosition rebasing = withExtensionHigh.withLock(extensionHighest, true, p.profitLockPrice(), ProfitLockState.TP_EXTENSION_REBASE,
 740:                         at == null ? Instant.now() : at);
 741:                 log.info("[FIX-120][REPLAY][TP_GEOMETRY_REBASE] positionId={}, previousState={}, newState={}, oldTarget={}, newTarget={}, " +
 742:                                 "extensionPrice={}, highest={}, newGeometryProgressPct={}, oldLock={}, freshLock={}, activationPct={}, geometryRebased=true",
 743:                         p.positionId(), p.profitLockState(), rebasing.profitLockState(), oldTarget, newTarget, extensionPrice,
 744:                         extensionHighest, progress, oldLock, rebasing.profitLockPrice(), activation);
 745:                 return rebasing;
 746:             }
 747:             // FIX-120 Production/Replay parity: the old executable lock belongs to the
 748:             // superseded TP geometry. If the extended winner still qualifies, establish a
 749:             // fresh geometry baseline. Raw extensionPrice is current; extensionHighest is the
 750:             // historical-best seed; previousActive/previousLock are deliberately discarded.
 751:             ReplayPolicyProfile settings = profile();
 752:             BigDecimal currentForPolicy = extensionPrice == null ? extensionHighest : extensionPrice;
 753:             ProfitLockPolicy.State rebased = profitLockPolicy.evaluate(
 754:                     p.entryPrice(), newTarget, currentForPolicy, extensionHighest,
 755:                     false, null, settings.dynamicProfitLockEnabled(), activation,
 756:                     settings.profitLockInitialPercent(), settings.profitLockTrailStepPercent());
 757:             if (rebased.active()) {
 758:                 ShadowPosition active = withExtensionHigh.withLock(rebased.highestPrice(), true, rebased.lockPrice(), ProfitLockState.ACTIVE, null);
 759:                 log.info("[FIX-120][REPLAY][TP_GEOMETRY_REBASE] positionId={}, previousState={}, newState={}, oldTarget={}, newTarget={}, " +
 760:                                 "extensionPrice={}, highest={}, newGeometryProgressPct={}, oldLock={}, freshLock={}, activationPct={}, geometryRebased=true",
 761:                         p.positionId(), p.profitLockState(), active.profitLockState(), oldTarget, newTarget, extensionPrice,
 762:                         rebased.highestPrice(), rebased.progressPercent(), oldLock, rebased.lockPrice(), activation);
 763:                 return active;
 764:             }
 765:             ShadowPosition rebasing = withExtensionHigh.withLock(rebased.highestPrice(), true, p.profitLockPrice(), ProfitLockState.TP_EXTENSION_REBASE,
 766:                     at == null ? Instant.now() : at);
 767:             log.info("[FIX-120][REPLAY][TP_GEOMETRY_REBASE] positionId={}, previousState={}, newState={}, oldTarget={}, newTarget={}, " +
 768:                             "extensionPrice={}, highest={}, newGeometryProgressPct={}, oldLock={}, freshLock={}, activationPct={}, geometryRebased=true",
 769:                     p.positionId(), p.profitLockState(), rebasing.profitLockState(), oldTarget, newTarget, extensionPrice,
 770:                     rebased.highestPrice(), rebased.progressPercent(), oldLock, rebasing.profitLockPrice(), activation);
 771:             return rebasing;
 772:         }
 773:         if (p.profitLockState() == ProfitLockState.TP_EXTENSION_REBASE) {
 774:             return withExtensionHigh.withLock(extensionHighest, true, p.profitLockPrice(), ProfitLockState.TP_EXTENSION_REBASE,
 775:                     p.profitLockRebaseStartedAt());
 776:         }
 777:         return withExtensionHigh;
 778:     }
 779: 
 780:     private BigDecimal progressPercent(BigDecimal entry, BigDecimal target, BigDecimal highest) {
 781:         if (entry == null || target == null || highest == null || target.compareTo(entry) <= 0) return BigDecimal.ZERO;
 782:         BigDecimal favorable = highest.subtract(entry);
 783:         if (favorable.signum() < 0) favorable = BigDecimal.ZERO;
 784:         return favorable.multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(100), MC)
 785:                 .divide(target.subtract(entry, MC), 6, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
 786:     }

 791:                 p.profitLockRebaseStartedAt() == null ? null : Timestamp.from(p.profitLockRebaseStartedAt()), p.positionId());

 814:     private String replayStage(int allocationPercent) {
 815:         if (allocationPercent <= 0) return "NONE";
 816:         if (allocationPercent < 50) return "SCOUT_ENTRY";
 817:         if (allocationPercent < 100) return "CONFIRMATION_ADD";
 818:         return "TREND_ADD";

 821:     private ShadowPosition addToPosition(long runId, ShadowPosition open, TradeSignal signal,
 822:                                          BigDecimal addedQty, BigDecimal addedCost, int addPercent) {
 823:         BigDecimal newQuantity = open.quantity().add(addedQty, MC);
 824:         BigDecimal newCost = open.cost().add(addedCost, MC);
 825:         BigDecimal newEntry = newCost.divide(newQuantity, 12, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
 826:         BigDecimal newStop = open.stopLoss();
 827:         if (signal.getStopLoss() != null && (newStop == null || signal.getStopLoss().compareTo(newStop) > 0)) {
 828:             newStop = signal.getStopLoss();
 829:         }
 830:         BigDecimal newTakeProfit = open.takeProfit();
 831:         if (signal.getTakeProfit() != null && (newTakeProfit == null || signal.getTakeProfit().compareTo(newTakeProfit) > 0)) {
 832:             newTakeProfit = signal.getTakeProfit();
 833:         }
 834:         int newPercent = Math.min(100, open.positionPercent() + addPercent);
 835:         jdbcTemplate.update("""
 836:                 UPDATE wallet_position_test
 837:                 SET entry_price=?, quantity=?, total_cost_usdt=?, position_percent=?,
 838:                     stop_loss_usdt=?, take_profit_usdt=?
 839:                 WHERE id=? AND test_run_id=?
 840:                 """, newEntry, newQuantity, newCost, newPercent, newStop, newTakeProfit,
 841:                 open.positionId(), runId);
 842:         ShadowPosition updated = open.withAdd(newEntry, newQuantity, newCost, newPercent, newStop, newTakeProfit);
 843:         persistNearTpState(updated);
 844:         return updated;
 845:     }

  60:                     """, caseName, symbol, Timestamp.from(request.startTime()), Timestamp.from(request.endTime()),
  61:                     request.walletId(), blankToNull(request.expectedAction()), blankToNull(request.notes()));
  62:         }
  63:         return investigationCases();
  64:     }

  67:     public List<Map<String, Object>> investigationCases() {

  70:                        c.expected_action, c.notes, c.last_run_id,

  85:                 SELECT id, case_name, symbol, start_time, end_time

 103:     private void validateInvestigationCase(RegressionInvestigationCaseRequest request) {
 104:         if (request == null || request.symbol() == null || request.symbol().isBlank()
 105:                 || request.startTime() == null || request.endTime() == null
 106:                 || !request.endTime().isAfter(request.startTime())) {
 107:             throw new IllegalArgumentException("Each investigation case requires symbol/start/end and end must be after start.");

 111:     private String blankToNull(String value) {
 112:         return value == null || value.isBlank() ? null : value.trim();
 113:     }
 114: 
 115:     /**
 116:      * FIX-089: only rows that pre-date this service/JVM instance can be leftovers from a real
 117:      * application restart. FIX-088 updated every PENDING/RUNNING row when ApplicationReadyEvent
 118:      * fired, which could falsely mark a replay created by the current JVM as interrupted.
 119:      *
 120:      * Capturing the service construction time makes the distinction deterministic: a replay row
 121:      * created after this instant belongs to the current application instance and must never be
 122:      * touched by startup recovery, even if ApplicationReadyEvent is delivered later than expected.
 123:      */
 124:     private final Instant serviceInstanceStartedAt = Instant.now();
 125: 
 126:     @EventListener(ApplicationReadyEvent.class)
 127:     public void markInterruptedRunsAfterRestart() {
 128:         jdbcTemplate.update("""
 129:                 UPDATE analysis_test_run
 130:                 SET status='ERROR', current_step='Interrupted by application restart',
 131:                     error_message='Replay was interrupted by an actual application restart. Resume is disabled; delete test data and start a new run.',
 132:                     completed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
 133:                 WHERE status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING')
 134:                   AND created_at < ?
 135:                 """, Timestamp.from(serviceInstanceStartedAt));
 136:     }
 137: 
 138:     // FIX-088: manual Resume was removed. We intentionally do not expose a method that
 139:     // mutates an existing failed run back to PENDING. Users delete test data and start a clean run.
 140: 
 141: 
 142:     /**
 143:      * FIX-090: request cooperative cancellation of exactly one active replay worker.
 144:      * We do not mark the row ERROR here because that would be a false claim while Java is
 145:      * still executing. RegressionTestWorker marks ERROR only after it actually unwinds.
 146:      */
 147:     public synchronized Map<String, Object> stopRun(long runId) {
 148:         List<Map<String, Object>> rows = jdbcTemplate.queryForList(
 149:                 "SELECT id,status,current_step FROM analysis_test_run WHERE id=?", runId);
 150:         if (rows.isEmpty()) throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Regression test #" + runId + " not found.");
 151:         String status = String.valueOf(rows.get(0).get("status"));
 152:         if (!("PENDING".equals(status) || "RUNNING".equals(status))) {
 153:             return Map.of("id", runId, "status", status, "activeWorker", worker.isActive(runId),
 154:                     "message", "Test is already stopped.");
 155:         }
 156:         boolean requested = worker.requestStop(runId);
 157:         if (!requested) {
 158:             // No worker in this JVM means it is already orphaned/stopped. Mark it ERROR now so
 159:             // Delete Data is not blocked forever by a stale RUNNING database status.
 160:             jdbcTemplate.update("""
 161:                     UPDATE analysis_test_run
 162:                     SET status='ERROR', current_step='Stopped by user',
 163:                         error_message='Replay worker was not active in this application instance; run marked stopped.',
 164:                         completed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), heartbeat_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
 165:                     WHERE id=? AND status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING')
 166:                     """, runId);
 167:             return Map.of("id", runId, "status", "ERROR", "activeWorker", false,
 168:                     "message", "Test had no active worker and is now stopped. You can Delete Data.");
 169:         }
 170:         jdbcTemplate.update("UPDATE analysis_test_run SET current_step='Stop requested �?" waiting for replay worker to exit', heartbeat_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=?", runId);
 171:         return Map.of("id", runId, "status", "STOPPING", "activeWorker", true,
 172:                 "message", "Stop requested. Delete Data will unlock after the replay worker has fully stopped.");
 173:     }

 175:     public synchronized long start(RegressionTestRunRequest request) {
 176:         return start(request, ReplayDataSource.DATABASE);
 177:     }
 178: 
 179:     /** FIX-11H explicit replay-only OLD/NEW selector. Production is not configurable through this mode. */
 180:     public synchronized long start(RegressionTestRunRequest request, ReplayDataSource dataSource) {
 181:         if (request == null || request.symbol() == null || request.symbol().isBlank()
 182:                 || request.startTime() == null || request.endTime() == null
 183:                 || !request.endTime().isAfter(request.startTime())) {
 184:             throw new IllegalArgumentException("Symbol, start time and end time are required, and end must be after start.");
 185:         }
 186: 
 187:         Integer activeRuns = jdbcTemplate.queryForObject("""
 188:                 SELECT COUNT(*)
 189:                 FROM analysis_test_run
 190:                 WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')
 191:                 """, Integer.class);
 192:         if (activeRuns != null && activeRuns > 0) {
 193:             Map<String, Object> active = jdbcTemplate.queryForMap("""
 194:                     SELECT id, test_name, symbol, status, progress_percent, started_at, created_at
 195:                     FROM analysis_test_run
 196:                     WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')
 197:                     ORDER BY id DESC
 198:                     LIMIT 1
 199:                     """);
 200:             throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
 201:                     "Regression test #" + active.get("id") + " is already " + active.get("status")
 202:                             + " for " + active.get("symbol") + ". Wait for it to finish before starting another run.");
 203:         }
 204: 
 205:         String symbol = request.symbol().trim().toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
 206:         ReplayDataSource effectiveSource = dataSource == null ? ReplayDataSource.DATABASE : dataSource;
 207:         String baseTestName = request.testName() == null || request.testName().isBlank()
 208:                 ? symbol + " regression" : request.testName().trim();
 209:         String testName = (baseTestName + " [" + effectiveSource.name() + "]").substring(
 210:                 0, Math.min(180, baseTestName.length() + effectiveSource.name().length() + 3));
 211: 
 212:         KeyHolder keyHolder = new GeneratedKeyHolder();
 213:         jdbcTemplate.update(connection -> {
 214:             PreparedStatement statement = connection.prepareStatement("""
 215:                     INSERT INTO analysis_test_run
 216:                         (test_name, symbol, start_time, end_time, status, progress_percent, current_step)
 217:                     VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'PENDING', 0, 'Queued from Administration')
 218:                     """, Statement.RETURN_GENERATED_KEYS);
 219:             statement.setString(1, testName);
 220:             statement.setString(2, symbol);
 221:             statement.setTimestamp(3, Timestamp.from(request.startTime()));
 222:             statement.setTimestamp(4, Timestamp.from(request.endTime()));
 223:             return statement;
 224:         }, keyHolder);
 225: 
 226:         Number key = keyHolder.getKey();
 227:         if (key == null) {
 228:             throw new IllegalStateException("Could not create regression test run.");
 229:         }
 230:         long id = key.longValue();
 231:         // FIX-156 / RET-01: do not persist a legacy shared experiment revision
 232:         // for baseline Replay. Its fixed parity policy is recorded by the
 233:         // immutable Replay profile/certificate work, not by FIX-122 state.
 234:         worker.runAsync(id, effectiveSource);
 235:         return id;
 236:     }

 239:     /**
 240:      * Archives one complete replay run before it can be cleared from the active test tables.
 241:      *
 242:      * IMPORTANT regression-history rule (introduced after the ETHUSDT Trade #2 investigation,
 243:      * Aug-2026): test rows are evidence. We must be able to rerun changed production logic without
 244:      * destroying the old pipeline/evidence/health/trade trace that still needs manual analysis.
 245:      * Proven trades remain separate in proven_analyzed_trade and are never moved or deleted here.
 246:      */
 247:     @Transactional
 248:     public synchronized Map<String, Object> archiveRun(long runId, String reason) {
 249:         Integer active = jdbcTemplate.queryForObject("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_test_run WHERE id=? AND status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING')", Integer.class, runId);
 250:         if (active != null && active > 0) {
 251:             throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "Test #" + runId + " is still running and cannot be archived.");
 252:         }
 253:         List<Map<String,Object>> rows = jdbcTemplate.queryForList("SELECT id,test_name,symbol,start_time,end_time,status FROM analysis_test_run WHERE id=?", runId);
 254:         if (rows.isEmpty()) throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Regression test #" + runId + " not found.");
 255:         List<Map<String,Object>> existing = jdbcTemplate.queryForList("SELECT id FROM regression_test_archive_batch WHERE source_test_run_id=?", runId);
 256:         if (!existing.isEmpty()) return Map.of("archiveBatchId", existing.get(0).get("id"), "sourceTestRunId", runId, "alreadyArchived", true);
 257:         Map<String,Object> r = rows.get(0);
 258:         KeyHolder kh = new GeneratedKeyHolder();
 259:         jdbcTemplate.update(c -> {
 260:             PreparedStatement ps = c.prepareStatement("INSERT INTO regression_test_archive_batch(source_test_run_id,test_name,symbol,start_time,end_time,source_status,archive_reason) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)", Statement.RETURN_GENERATED_KEYS);
 261:             ps.setLong(1, runId); ps.setString(2, String.valueOf(r.get("test_name"))); ps.setString(3, String.valueOf(r.get("symbol")));
 262:             ps.setTimestamp(4, (Timestamp) r.get("start_time")); ps.setTimestamp(5, (Timestamp) r.get("end_time"));
 263:             ps.setString(6, String.valueOf(r.get("status"))); ps.setString(7, reason == null || reason.isBlank() ? "Archived before replay reset" : reason.trim());
 264:             return ps;
 265:         }, kh);
 266:         long batchId = kh.getKey().longValue();
 267:         int runs = jdbcTemplate.update("INSERT INTO analysis_test_run_archive SELECT ?, r.* FROM analysis_test_run r WHERE r.id=?", batchId, runId);
 268:         int signals = jdbcTemplate.update("INSERT INTO analysis_test_signal_archive SELECT ?, r.* FROM analysis_test_signal r WHERE r.test_run_id=?", batchId, runId);
 269:         // FIX-069: archive the full production-shaped replay signal snapshot as well.
 270:         int fullTradeSignals = jdbcTemplate.update("INSERT INTO trade_signal_test_archive SELECT ?, r.* FROM trade_signal_test r WHERE r.test_run_id=?", batchId, runId);
 271:         int opportunities = jdbcTemplate.update("INSERT INTO execution_opportunity_test_archive SELECT ?, r.* FROM execution_opportunity_test r WHERE r.test_run_id=?", batchId, runId);
 272:         int results = jdbcTemplate.update("INSERT INTO analysis_test_result_archive SELECT ?, r.* FROM analysis_test_result r WHERE r.test_run_id=?", batchId, runId);
 273:         int executions = jdbcTemplate.update("INSERT INTO wallet_execution_test_archive SELECT ?, r.* FROM wallet_execution_test r WHERE r.test_run_id=?", batchId, runId);
 274:         int positions = jdbcTemplate.update("INSERT INTO wallet_position_test_archive SELECT ?, r.* FROM wallet_position_test r WHERE r.test_run_id=?", batchId, runId);
 275:         int management = jdbcTemplate.update("INSERT INTO position_management_test_archive SELECT ?, r.* FROM position_management_test r WHERE r.test_run_id=?", batchId, runId);
 276:         int defensiveObservations = jdbcTemplate.update("INSERT INTO defensive_risk_reduction_observation_test_archive SELECT ?, r.* FROM defensive_risk_reduction_observation_test r WHERE r.test_run_id=?", batchId, runId);
 277:         int continuationGraceObservations = jdbcTemplate.update("INSERT INTO one_candle_continuation_grace_test_archive SELECT ?, r.* FROM one_candle_continuation_grace_test r WHERE r.test_run_id=?", batchId, runId);
 278:         return Map.ofEntries(
 279:                 Map.entry("archiveBatchId", batchId), Map.entry("sourceTestRunId", runId), Map.entry("alreadyArchived", false),
 280:                 Map.entry("runs", runs), Map.entry("signals", signals), Map.entry("tradeSignals", fullTradeSignals),
 281:                 Map.entry("opportunities", opportunities), Map.entry("results", results), Map.entry("executions", executions),
 282:                 Map.entry("positions", positions), Map.entry("management", management),
 283:                 Map.entry("defensiveRiskObservations", defensiveObservations),
 284:                 Map.entry("oneCandleContinuationGraceObservations", continuationGraceObservations));
 285:     }

 314:     @Transactional
 315:     public synchronized Map<String, Object> resetAllTestData() {
 316:         // FIX-090: Java worker ownership is authoritative. Database ERROR may be written a few
 317:         // milliseconds before runAsync finally releases ownership; never purge during that gap.
 318:         if (worker.hasActiveRuns()) {
 319:             throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
 320:                     "A Replay/Test worker is still active. Stop it and wait for the worker to fully exit before Delete Data.");
 321:         }
 322:         Integer activeRuns = jdbcTemplate.queryForObject("""
 323:                 SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_test_run
 324:                 WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')
 325:                 """, Integer.class);
 326:         if (activeRuns != null && activeRuns > 0) {
 327:             List<Map<String,Object>> liveRows = jdbcTemplate.queryForList(
 328:                     "SELECT id,status FROM analysis_test_run WHERE status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING')");
 329:             boolean workerStillActive = liveRows.stream()
 330:                     .anyMatch(r -> worker.isActive(((Number) r.get("id")).longValue()));
 331:             if (workerStillActive) {
 332:                 throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
 333:                         "A Replay/Test worker is still active. Use Stop Test and wait until it becomes ERROR before Delete Data.");
 334:             }
 335:             // Defensive cleanup for a stale DB status with no Java worker.
 336:             jdbcTemplate.update("""
 337:                     UPDATE analysis_test_run SET status='ERROR', current_step='Stopped/orphaned worker',
 338:                         error_message='No active Replay/Test worker exists in this application instance.',
 339:                         completed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
 340:                     WHERE status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING')
 341:                     """);
 342:         }
 343: 
 344:         // FIX-088: Delete Data is now a true purge, not an archive operation. Every replay/test
 345:         // table that can feed Recent Test Runs, run detail, Shadow Trades, or archived replay
 346:         // history is emptied. Persistent Proven records are deliberately excluded.
 347:         int provenBefore = countRows("proven_analyzed_trade");
 348:         int provenLegsBefore = countRows("proven_trade_leg_archive");
 349: 
 350:         Map<String, Integer> deleted = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();
 351:         // Delete children before parents so the purge remains safe if foreign keys are added later.
 352:         deleted.put("one_candle_continuation_grace_test", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM one_candle_continuation_grace_test"));
 353:         deleted.put("defensive_risk_reduction_observation_test", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM defensive_risk_reduction_observation_test"));
 354:         deleted.put("position_management_test", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM position_management_test"));
 355:         deleted.put("wallet_execution_test", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM wallet_execution_test"));
 356:         deleted.put("wallet_position_test", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM wallet_position_test"));
 357:         deleted.put("execution_opportunity_test", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM execution_opportunity_test"));
 358:         deleted.put("trade_signal_test", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM trade_signal_test"));
 359:         deleted.put("analysis_test_signal", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM analysis_test_signal"));
 360:         deleted.put("analysis_test_result", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM analysis_test_result"));
 361:         // FIX-156 / O-8: the only allowed shared diagnostic-table operation
 362:         // stays explicit and run-owned; it cannot delete a Production row.
 363:         deleted.put("fix122_evaluation", replayFix122EvaluationStore.purgeReplayRows());
 364:         deleted.put("analysis_test_run", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM analysis_test_run"));
 365: 
 366:         deleted.put("one_candle_continuation_grace_test_archive", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM one_candle_continuation_grace_test_archive"));
 367:         deleted.put("defensive_risk_reduction_observation_test_archive", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM defensive_risk_reduction_observation_test_archive"));
 368:         deleted.put("position_management_test_archive", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM position_management_test_archive"));
 369:         deleted.put("wallet_execution_test_archive", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM wallet_execution_test_archive"));
 370:         deleted.put("wallet_position_test_archive", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM wallet_position_test_archive"));
 371:         deleted.put("execution_opportunity_test_archive", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM execution_opportunity_test_archive"));
 372:         deleted.put("trade_signal_test_archive", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM trade_signal_test_archive"));
 373:         deleted.put("analysis_test_signal_archive", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM analysis_test_signal_archive"));
 374:         deleted.put("analysis_test_result_archive", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM analysis_test_result_archive"));
 375:         deleted.put("analysis_test_run_archive", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM analysis_test_run_archive"));
 376:         deleted.put("regression_test_archive_batch", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM regression_test_archive_batch"));
 377: 
 378:         // Validate the database state inside this same transaction. If any replay table still
 379:         // contains rows, throw and rollback instead of reporting a false successful purge.
 380:         java.util.List<String> replayTables = java.util.List.of(
 381:                 "one_candle_continuation_grace_test", "defensive_risk_reduction_observation_test", "position_management_test", "wallet_execution_test", "wallet_position_test",
 382:                 "execution_opportunity_test", "trade_signal_test", "analysis_test_signal",
 383:                 "analysis_test_result", "analysis_test_run",
 384:                 "one_candle_continuation_grace_test_archive", "defensive_risk_reduction_observation_test_archive", "position_management_test_archive", "wallet_execution_test_archive",
 385:                 "wallet_position_test_archive", "execution_opportunity_test_archive",
 386:                 "trade_signal_test_archive", "analysis_test_signal_archive",
 387:                 "analysis_test_result_archive", "analysis_test_run_archive",
 388:                 "regression_test_archive_batch");
 389:         Map<String, Integer> remaining = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();
 390:         for (String table : replayTables) remaining.put(table, countRows(table));
 391:         java.util.List<String> nonEmpty = remaining.entrySet().stream()
 392:                 .filter(e -> e.getValue() != 0).map(Map.Entry::getKey).toList();
 393:         if (!nonEmpty.isEmpty()) {
 394:             throw new IllegalStateException("Delete Test Data validation failed; rows remain in: " + String.join(", ", nonEmpty));
 395:         }
 396: 
 397:         int provenAfter = countRows("proven_analyzed_trade");
 398:         int provenLegsAfter = countRows("proven_trade_leg_archive");
 399:         if (provenBefore != provenAfter || provenLegsBefore != provenLegsAfter) {
 400:             throw new IllegalStateException("Delete Test Data validation failed; Proven records changed unexpectedly.");
 401:         }
 402: 
 403:         // Reset only tables that own an AUTO_INCREMENT id. This is cosmetic and happens only
 404:         // after successful delete + validation; Proven ids are never reset.

 543:     private ExitDecision evaluateExit(long runId, ShadowPosition p, TradeSignal s, TradeSignal oneMinute, TradeSignal five, TradeSignal one) {
 544:         BigDecimal price = s.getLatestPrice();
 545:         if (price == null) return ExitDecision.hold();
 546: 
 547:         // Replay uses the exact same temporal price-authority rule as production. A signal
 548:         // generated later may still carry a candle close from before entry; that historical
 549:         // price may update MTF context but may not retroactively hit TP/SL/profit-lock.
 550:         boolean authoritativePrice = priceAuthorityPolicy.canUseSignalPrice(s, p.entryTime());
 551:         if (authoritativePrice && p.takeProfit() != null && price.compareTo(p.takeProfit()) >= 0) {
 552:             // Exact production TP-continuation call, including immutable entry structure.
 553:             // FIX-011 regression relies on Replay and live using this same shared policy.
 554:             PositionContinuationPolicy.Evaluation continuation = continuationPolicy.evaluate(
 555:                     oneMinute != null ? oneMinute : s, five, one,
 556:                     p.entryTrend(), p.entryStructure(), p.entryMomentum(), p.entryVolume(),
 557:                     p.entryConfidence(), p.entryScore());
 558:             if (continuation.extendTarget()) {
 559:                 BigDecimal distance = p.takeProfit().subtract(p.entryPrice());
 560:                 BigDecimal newTarget = p.takeProfit().add(distance.multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(0.50), MC), MC);
 561:                 persistManagement(runId, s, "TAKE_PROFIT_EXTENDED", p.takeProfit(), newTarget, p, continuation.explanation());
 562:                 jdbcTemplate.update("UPDATE wallet_position_test SET take_profit_usdt=? WHERE id=?", newTarget, p.positionId());
 563:                 return new ExitDecision(false, "EXTEND_TAKE_PROFIT", continuation.explanation(), newTarget);
 564:             }
 565:             persistManagement(runId, s, "TAKE_PROFIT_EXIT", p.takeProfit(), p.takeProfit(), p, continuation.explanation());
 566:             return new ExitDecision(true, "TAKE_PROFIT", continuation.explanation());
 567:         }
 568:         // FIX-052 fallback ordering also mirrors Production: STOP_LOSS is absolute and
 569:         // is evaluated before profit-lock. Exact V64 runs normally take this path from
 570:         // persisted live-price events rather than from signal-carried prices.
 571:         if (authoritativePrice && p.stopLoss() != null && price.compareTo(p.stopLoss()) <= 0)
 572:             return new ExitDecision(true, "STOP_LOSS", "Price reached the stored stop loss.");
 573: 
 574:         ShadowPosition updated = authoritativePrice ? profitLockState(p, price) : p;
 575:         if (authoritativePrice && (updated.profitLockState() == ProfitLockState.ACTIVE
 576:                 || updated.profitLockState() == ProfitLockState.TP_EXTENSION_REBASE
 577:                 || p.profitLockActive() != updated.profitLockActive()
 578:                 || !equalsNullable(p.profitLockPrice(), updated.profitLockPrice())
 579:                 || p.profitLockState() != updated.profitLockState())) {
 580:             BigDecimal fix118Progress = updated.takeProfit() == null || updated.takeProfit().compareTo(updated.entryPrice()) <= 0
 581:                     ? BigDecimal.ZERO
 582:                     : updated.highest().subtract(updated.entryPrice(), MC)
 583:                             .multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(100), MC)
 584:                             .divide(updated.takeProfit().subtract(updated.entryPrice(), MC), 6, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
 585:             log.info("[FIX-118][REPLAY][SIGNAL_PATH] runId={}, positionId={}, signalId={}, symbol={}, generatedAt={}, price={}, " +
 586:                             "entry={}, target={}, highest={}, previousActive={}, active={}, previousState={}, state={}, previousLock={}, lock={}, progressPct={}, triggered={}",
 587:                     runId, updated.positionId(), s.getId(), s.getSymbol(), s.getGeneratedAt(), price,
 588:                     updated.entryPrice(), updated.takeProfit(), updated.highest(), p.profitLockActive(), updated.profitLockActive(),
 589:                     p.profitLockState(), updated.profitLockState(), p.profitLockPrice(), updated.profitLockPrice(), fix118Progress,
 590:                     updated.profitLockState() == ProfitLockState.ACTIVE && updated.profitLockPrice() != null
 591:                             && price.compareTo(updated.profitLockPrice()) <= 0);
 592:         }
 593:         BigDecimal minimumProfitableExit = p.entryPrice().multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(1.0005));
 594:         if (authoritativePrice && updated.profitLockState() == ProfitLockState.TP_EXTENSION_REBASE
 595:                 && price.compareTo(minimumProfitableExit) < 0) {
 596:             String floorReason = "TP-extension rebase safety floor was breached at " + minimumProfitableExit + ". "
 597:                     + profitLockConfigText();
 598:             log.info("[FIX-118][REPLAY][SIGNAL_REBASE_HARD_FLOOR] runId={}, positionId={}, signalId={}, symbol={}, generatedAt={}, price={}, floor={}",
 599:                     runId, updated.positionId(), s.getId(), s.getSymbol(), s.getGeneratedAt(), price, minimumProfitableExit);
 600:             persistManagement(runId, s, "PROFIT_LOCK_HARD_EXIT", p.takeProfit(), p.takeProfit(), updated, floorReason);
 601:             return new ExitDecision(true, "PROFIT_LOCK_HARD_EXIT", floorReason);
 602:         }
 603:         if (authoritativePrice && updated.profitLockState() == ProfitLockState.ACTIVE && updated.profitLockPrice() != null
 604:                 && price.compareTo(updated.profitLockPrice()) <= 0) {
 605:             log.info("[FIX-118][REPLAY][SIGNAL_TRIGGER] runId={}, positionId={}, signalId={}, symbol={}, generatedAt={}, price={}, lock={}, target={}",
 606:                     runId, updated.positionId(), s.getId(), s.getSymbol(), s.getGeneratedAt(), price,
 607:                     updated.profitLockPrice(), updated.takeProfit());
 608:             if (price.compareTo(minimumProfitableExit) < 0) {
 609:                 String floorReason = "Profit-lock hard floor was breached; protected profit can no longer be preserved. "
 610:                         + profitLockConfigText();
 611:                 persistManagement(runId, s, "PROFIT_LOCK_HARD_EXIT", p.takeProfit(), p.takeProfit(), updated, floorReason);
 612:                 return new ExitDecision(true, "PROFIT_LOCK_HARD_EXIT", floorReason);
 613:             }
 614:             PositionExitPolicy.Evaluation lockDecision = exitPolicy.evaluateProfitLockBreach(
 615:                     oneMinute != null ? oneMinute : s, five, one);
 616:             if (!lockDecision.exit()) {
 617:                 String holdReason = lockDecision.explanation() + " " + profitLockConfigText();
 618:                 persistManagement(runId, s, "PROFIT_LOCK_HOLD", p.takeProfit(), p.takeProfit(), updated, holdReason);
 619:                 return ExitDecision.hold();
 620:             }
 621:             String lockReason = "Price retraced to the protected profit level after a profitable advance. "
 622:                     + lockDecision.explanation() + " " + profitLockConfigText();
 623:             persistManagement(runId, s, "PROFIT_LOCK_EXIT", p.takeProfit(), p.takeProfit(), updated, lockReason);
 624:             return new ExitDecision(true, lockDecision.code(), lockReason);
 625:         }
 626:         // Production has two SELL authorities: the live HTF PositionExitPolicy and the
 627:         // 1m signal TradeExecutionValidationService. Replay executes both shared production
 628:         // policies in the same order instead of carrying a test-only SELL rule.
 629:         PositionExitPolicy.Evaluation normalExit = exitPolicy.evaluateNormalExit(
 630:                 oneMinute != null ? oneMinute : s, five, one);
 631:         if (normalExit.exit()) {
 632:             return new ExitDecision(true, normalExit.code(), normalExit.explanation());
 633:         }
 634:         if ("1m".equals(s.getInterval()) && bearish(s.getDecision())) {
 635:             ReplaySellValidationPolicy.Result validatedSell = replaySellValidationPolicy.validate(s, five, one);
 636:             if (validatedSell.allowed()) {
 637:                 return new ExitDecision(true, validatedSell.code(), validatedSell.explanation());
 638:             }
 639:         }
 640:         return ExitDecision.hold();
 641:     }

 643:     private FallbackNearTpEvaluation evaluateNearTpAtSignalFallback(long runId, ShadowPosition current,

 658:         }

 664:         if (!minimumCheck.executable()) {

 691:                 || p.profitLockState() != n.profitLockState()

 693:             jdbcTemplate.update("UPDATE wallet_position_test SET highest_price_usdt=?, profit_lock_active=?, profit_lock_price_usdt=?, profit_lock_state=?, profit_lock_rebase_started_at=? WHERE id=?",
 694:                     n.highest(), n.profitLockActive(), n.profitLockPrice(), n.profitLockState().name(),
 695:                     n.profitLockRebaseStartedAt() == null ? null : Timestamp.from(n.profitLockRebaseStartedAt()), p.positionId());

 700:     private ShadowPosition profitLockState(ShadowPosition p, BigDecimal price) {
 701:         ReplayPolicyProfile settings = profile();
 702:         BigDecimal activation = settings.profitLockActivationPercent();
 703:         BigDecimal highest = p.highest() == null ? price : p.highest().max(price);
 704:         BigDecimal progress = progressPercent(p.entryPrice(), p.takeProfit(), highest);
 705: 
 706:         if (p.profitLockState() == ProfitLockState.TP_EXTENSION_REBASE
 707:                 && progress.compareTo(activation) < 0) {
 708:             // Replay parity with Production FIX-118: preserve the historical lock/legacy flag,
 709:             // but keep it non-executable until the new TP geometry earns activation again.
 710:             return p.withLock(highest, true, p.profitLockPrice(), ProfitLockState.TP_EXTENSION_REBASE,
 711:                     p.profitLockRebaseStartedAt());
 712:         }
 713: 
 714:         // FIX-118 parity: when REBASE earns activation, rebuild the lock from the current
 715:         // TP geometry instead of retaining the superseded pre-extension lock.
 716:         boolean freshGeometryActivation = p.profitLockState() == ProfitLockState.TP_EXTENSION_REBASE;
 717:         ProfitLockPolicy.State state = profitLockPolicy.evaluate(
 718:                 p.entryPrice(), p.takeProfit(), price, highest,
 719:                 freshGeometryActivation ? false : (p.profitLockState() == ProfitLockState.ACTIVE || p.profitLockActive()),
 720:                 freshGeometryActivation ? null : p.profitLockPrice(),
 721:                 settings.dynamicProfitLockEnabled(), activation,
 722:                 settings.profitLockInitialPercent(), settings.profitLockTrailStepPercent());
 723:         ProfitLockState nextState = state.active() ? ProfitLockState.ACTIVE : ProfitLockState.INACTIVE;
 724:         return p.withLock(state.highestPrice(), state.active(), state.lockPrice(), nextState, null);
 725:     }

 727:     private ShadowPosition rebaseForExtendedTarget(ShadowPosition p, BigDecimal newTarget, BigDecimal extensionPrice, Instant at) {
 728:         if (p == null || newTarget == null) return p;
 729:         BigDecimal oldTarget = p.takeProfit();

 735:                 p.profitLockState(), p.profitLockRebaseStartedAt());

 744:                         extensionHighest, progress, oldLock, rebasing.profitLockPrice(), activation);
 745:                 return rebasing;
 746:             }
 747:             // FIX-120 Production/Replay parity: the old executable lock belongs to the
 748:             // superseded TP geometry. If the extended winner still qualifies, establish a
 749:             // fresh geometry baseline. Raw extensionPrice is current; extensionHighest is the
 750:             // historical-best seed; previousActive/previousLock are deliberately discarded.
 751:             ReplayPolicyProfile settings = profile();

 758:                 ShadowPosition active = withExtensionHigh.withLock(rebased.highestPrice(), true, rebased.lockPrice(), ProfitLockState.ACTIVE, null);
 759:                 log.info("[FIX-120][REPLAY][TP_GEOMETRY_REBASE] positionId={}, previousState={}, newState={}, oldTarget={}, newTarget={}, " +
 760:                                 "extensionPrice={}, highest={}, newGeometryProgressPct={}, oldLock={}, freshLock={}, activationPct={}, geometryRebased=true",

 760:                                 "extensionPrice={}, highest={}, newGeometryProgressPct={}, oldLock={}, freshLock={}, activationPct={}, geometryRebased=true",
 761:                         p.positionId(), p.profitLockState(), active.profitLockState(), oldTarget, newTarget, extensionPrice,
 762:                         rebased.highestPrice(), rebased.progressPercent(), oldLock, rebased.lockPrice(), activation);
 763:                 return active;
 764:             }
 765:             ShadowPosition rebasing = withExtensionHigh.withLock(rebased.highestPrice(), true, p.profitLockPrice(), ProfitLockState.TP_EXTENSION_REBASE,
 766:                     at == null ? Instant.now() : at);

 773:         if (p.profitLockState() == ProfitLockState.TP_EXTENSION_REBASE) {
 774:             return withExtensionHigh.withLock(extensionHighest, true, p.profitLockPrice(), ProfitLockState.TP_EXTENSION_REBASE,

 780:     private BigDecimal progressPercent(BigDecimal entry, BigDecimal target, BigDecimal highest) {
 781:         if (entry == null || target == null || highest == null || target.compareTo(entry) <= 0) return BigDecimal.ZERO;
 782:         BigDecimal favorable = highest.subtract(entry);
 783:         if (favorable.signum() < 0) favorable = BigDecimal.ZERO;
 784:         return favorable.multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(100), MC)
 785:                 .divide(target.subtract(entry, MC), 6, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
 786:     }

 791:                 p.profitLockRebaseStartedAt() == null ? null : Timestamp.from(p.profitLockRebaseStartedAt()), p.positionId());
 792:     }

 814:     private String replayStage(int allocationPercent) {
 815:         if (allocationPercent <= 0) return "NONE";
 816:         if (allocationPercent < 50) return "SCOUT_ENTRY";
 817:         if (allocationPercent < 100) return "CONFIRMATION_ADD";

 821:     private ShadowPosition addToPosition(long runId, ShadowPosition open, TradeSignal signal,
 822:                                          BigDecimal addedQty, BigDecimal addedCost, int addPercent) {
 823:         BigDecimal newQuantity = open.quantity().add(addedQty, MC);
 824:         BigDecimal newCost = open.cost().add(addedCost, MC);
 825:         BigDecimal newEntry = newCost.divide(newQuantity, 12, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
 826:         BigDecimal newStop = open.stopLoss();
 827:         if (signal.getStopLoss() != null && (newStop == null || signal.getStopLoss().compareTo(newStop) > 0)) {
 828:             newStop = signal.getStopLoss();
 829:         }
 830:         BigDecimal newTakeProfit = open.takeProfit();
 831:         if (signal.getTakeProfit() != null && (newTakeProfit == null || signal.getTakeProfit().compareTo(newTakeProfit) > 0)) {

 543:     private ExitDecision evaluateExit(long runId, ShadowPosition p, TradeSignal s, TradeSignal oneMinute, TradeSignal five, TradeSignal one) {
 544:         BigDecimal price = s.getLatestPrice();
 545:         if (price == null) return ExitDecision.hold();
 546: 
 547:         // Replay uses the exact same temporal price-authority rule as production. A signal
 548:         // generated later may still carry a candle close from before entry; that historical
 549:         // price may update MTF context but may not retroactively hit TP/SL/profit-lock.
 550:         boolean authoritativePrice = priceAuthorityPolicy.canUseSignalPrice(s, p.entryTime());
 551:         if (authoritativePrice && p.takeProfit() != null && price.compareTo(p.takeProfit()) >= 0) {
 552:             // Exact production TP-continuation call, including immutable entry structure.
 553:             // FIX-011 regression relies on Replay and live using this same shared policy.
 554:             PositionContinuationPolicy.Evaluation continuation = continuationPolicy.evaluate(
 555:                     oneMinute != null ? oneMinute : s, five, one,
 556:                     p.entryTrend(), p.entryStructure(), p.entryMomentum(), p.entryVolume(),
 557:                     p.entryConfidence(), p.entryScore());
 558:             if (continuation.extendTarget()) {
 559:                 BigDecimal distance = p.takeProfit().subtract(p.entryPrice());
 560:                 BigDecimal newTarget = p.takeProfit().add(distance.multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(0.50), MC), MC);
 561:                 persistManagement(runId, s, "TAKE_PROFIT_EXTENDED", p.takeProfit(), newTarget, p, continuation.explanation());
 562:                 jdbcTemplate.update("UPDATE wallet_position_test SET take_profit_usdt=? WHERE id=?", newTarget, p.positionId());
 563:                 return new ExitDecision(false, "EXTEND_TAKE_PROFIT", continuation.explanation(), newTarget);
 564:             }
 565:             persistManagement(runId, s, "TAKE_PROFIT_EXIT", p.takeProfit(), p.takeProfit(), p, continuation.explanation());
 566:             return new ExitDecision(true, "TAKE_PROFIT", continuation.explanation());
 567:         }
 568:         // FIX-052 fallback ordering also mirrors Production: STOP_LOSS is absolute and
 569:         // is evaluated before profit-lock. Exact V64 runs normally take this path from
 570:         // persisted live-price events rather than from signal-carried prices.
 571:         if (authoritativePrice && p.stopLoss() != null && price.compareTo(p.stopLoss()) <= 0)
 572:             return new ExitDecision(true, "STOP_LOSS", "Price reached the stored stop loss.");
 573: 
 574:         ShadowPosition updated = authoritativePrice ? profitLockState(p, price) : p;
 575:         if (authoritativePrice && (updated.profitLockState() == ProfitLockState.ACTIVE
 576:                 || updated.profitLockState() == ProfitLockState.TP_EXTENSION_REBASE
 577:                 || p.profitLockActive() != updated.profitLockActive()
 578:                 || !equalsNullable(p.profitLockPrice(), updated.profitLockPrice())
 579:                 || p.profitLockState() != updated.profitLockState())) {
 580:             BigDecimal fix118Progress = updated.takeProfit() == null || updated.takeProfit().compareTo(updated.entryPrice()) <= 0
 581:                     ? BigDecimal.ZERO
 582:                     : updated.highest().subtract(updated.entryPrice(), MC)
 583:                             .multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(100), MC)
 584:                             .divide(updated.takeProfit().subtract(updated.entryPrice(), MC), 6, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
 585:             log.info("[FIX-118][REPLAY][SIGNAL_PATH] runId={}, positionId={}, signalId={}, symbol={}, generatedAt={}, price={}, " +
 586:                             "entry={}, target={}, highest={}, previousActive={}, active={}, previousState={}, state={}, previousLock={}, lock={}, progressPct={}, triggered={}",
 587:                     runId, updated.positionId(), s.getId(), s.getSymbol(), s.getGeneratedAt(), price,
 588:                     updated.entryPrice(), updated.takeProfit(), updated.highest(), p.profitLockActive(), updated.profitLockActive(),
 589:                     p.profitLockState(), updated.profitLockState(), p.profitLockPrice(), updated.profitLockPrice(), fix118Progress,
 590:                     updated.profitLockState() == ProfitLockState.ACTIVE && updated.profitLockPrice() != null
 591:                             && price.compareTo(updated.profitLockPrice()) <= 0);
 592:         }
 593:         BigDecimal minimumProfitableExit = p.entryPrice().multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(1.0005));
 594:         if (authoritativePrice && updated.profitLockState() == ProfitLockState.TP_EXTENSION_REBASE
 595:                 && price.compareTo(minimumProfitableExit) < 0) {
 596:             String floorReason = "TP-extension rebase safety floor was breached at " + minimumProfitableExit + ". "
 597:                     + profitLockConfigText();
 598:             log.info("[FIX-118][REPLAY][SIGNAL_REBASE_HARD_FLOOR] runId={}, positionId={}, signalId={}, symbol={}, generatedAt={}, price={}, floor={}",
 599:                     runId, updated.positionId(), s.getId(), s.getSymbol(), s.getGeneratedAt(), price, minimumProfitableExit);
 600:             persistManagement(runId, s, "PROFIT_LOCK_HARD_EXIT", p.takeProfit(), p.takeProfit(), updated, floorReason);
 601:             return new ExitDecision(true, "PROFIT_LOCK_HARD_EXIT", floorReason);
 602:         }
 603:         if (authoritativePrice && updated.profitLockState() == ProfitLockState.ACTIVE && updated.profitLockPrice() != null
 604:                 && price.compareTo(updated.profitLockPrice()) <= 0) {
 605:             log.info("[FIX-118][REPLAY][SIGNAL_TRIGGER] runId={}, positionId={}, signalId={}, symbol={}, generatedAt={}, price={}, lock={}, target={}",
 606:                     runId, updated.positionId(), s.getId(), s.getSymbol(), s.getGeneratedAt(), price,
 607:                     updated.profitLockPrice(), updated.takeProfit());
 608:             if (price.compareTo(minimumProfitableExit) < 0) {
 609:                 String floorReason = "Profit-lock hard floor was breached; protected profit can no longer be preserved. "
 610:                         + profitLockConfigText();
 611:                 persistManagement(runId, s, "PROFIT_LOCK_HARD_EXIT", p.takeProfit(), p.takeProfit(), updated, floorReason);
 612:                 return new ExitDecision(true, "PROFIT_LOCK_HARD_EXIT", floorReason);
 613:             }
 614:             PositionExitPolicy.Evaluation lockDecision = exitPolicy.evaluateProfitLockBreach(

 700:     private ShadowPosition profitLockState(ShadowPosition p, BigDecimal price) {
 701:         ReplayPolicyProfile settings = profile();
 702:         BigDecimal activation = settings.profitLockActivationPercent();
 703:         BigDecimal highest = p.highest() == null ? price : p.highest().max(price);
 704:         BigDecimal progress = progressPercent(p.entryPrice(), p.takeProfit(), highest);
 705: 
 706:         if (p.profitLockState() == ProfitLockState.TP_EXTENSION_REBASE
 707:                 && progress.compareTo(activation) < 0) {
 708:             // Replay parity with Production FIX-118: preserve the historical lock/legacy flag,
 709:             // but keep it non-executable until the new TP geometry earns activation again.
 710:             return p.withLock(highest, true, p.profitLockPrice(), ProfitLockState.TP_EXTENSION_REBASE,
 711:                     p.profitLockRebaseStartedAt());
 712:         }
 713: 
 714:         // FIX-118 parity: when REBASE earns activation, rebuild the lock from the current
 715:         // TP geometry instead of retaining the superseded pre-extension lock.
 716:         boolean freshGeometryActivation = p.profitLockState() == ProfitLockState.TP_EXTENSION_REBASE;
 717:         ProfitLockPolicy.State state = profitLockPolicy.evaluate(
 718:                 p.entryPrice(), p.takeProfit(), price, highest,
 719:                 freshGeometryActivation ? false : (p.profitLockState() == ProfitLockState.ACTIVE || p.profitLockActive()),
 720:                 freshGeometryActivation ? null : p.profitLockPrice(),
 721:                 settings.dynamicProfitLockEnabled(), activation,
 722:                 settings.profitLockInitialPercent(), settings.profitLockTrailStepPercent());
 723:         ProfitLockState nextState = state.active() ? ProfitLockState.ACTIVE : ProfitLockState.INACTIVE;
 724:         return p.withLock(state.highestPrice(), state.active(), state.lockPrice(), nextState, null);

   7: **RPR-0.9.12 SHA-256:** `ddfd5f64a95f6b55ed39e8bffa7b4c93bd65f4e6dd3b23d8bf821500de722b24`  
   8: **Owner decision O-8:** RPR-0.9.12 incorporates option (a), the narrowly scoped `fix122_evaluation` exception in its Section 2.1 and in D48/R156-05/T156-09b.  
   9: **This document review SHA-256:** Pending final freeze; calculate and record it in the review request only after the last content edit.

  11: 
  12: ## 1. Fixed scope and earned results
  13: 
  14: FIX-156 changes **Replay only**. It does not change Production source,
  15: behaviour, database writes, account state, schedulers, HTTP traffic, or
  16: latency. Replay is a manual single-symbol research tool with fixed notional
  17: output. It is not a wallet, balance, cash, reserve, budget, portfolio, or
  18: historical-fill simulator.
  19: 
  20: A run has two independent earned certification dimensions:
  21: 
  22: - `ANALYSIS_PARITY`: a qualified Production signal/outcome is reproduced
  23:   using as-of evidence.
  24: - `LIFECYCLE_PARITY`: a qualified recorded-entry lifecycle passes the
  25:   separate lifecycle metric and critical-safety gate.
  26: 
  27: A run may earn neither, one, or both dimensions. `REFUSED_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE`
  28: and `FAILED_REPLAY` are terminal states which prevent either claim.
  29: `FAILED_REPLAY` is only for a technical error, cancellation, or failed
  30: staging. A business mismatch is published as parity-not-earned with its first
  31: divergence; it is not a technical failure.
  32: 
  33: No result may claim wallet, account, exact-fill, live-scheduling, MySQL-lock,
  34: or Binance-availability parity.
  35: 
  36: ## 2. Decided owner rules
  37: 
  38: | Decision | Implementable rule |
  39: | --- | --- |
  40: | O-1 | Replay never calls `wallet_settings` or shared `validateBuy`. A Replay-local BUY mirror reads only a frozen policy profile. |
  41: | O-2 | Signal and lifecycle parity are separate certification dimensions. |
  42: | O-3 | Every class reachable from a Replay request or worker is inside the boundary. |
  43: | O-4 | The 99% result is separate per metric, based on a frozen lower confidence bound, coverage floor, and critical-safety gate. |
  44: | O-5 | A lifecycle fixture carries the full recorded timeline, not entry only. |
  45: | O-6 | No separate Replay database identity/datasource is introduced. |
  46: | O-7 | No shared-datasource SQL guard is introduced. Replay safety is application/test enforced, not a database-permission claim. |
  47: | O-8 / D48 | Replay may use `fix122_evaluation` only through the exact run-owned and display-only operations in Section 4.2a. This exception never supplies decision, wallet, account, fill, or Production-trading authority. |

  83: 
  84: ### 4.2a `fix122_evaluation` transitional shared-table exception and delete policy
  85: 
  86: `fix122_evaluation` is a shared diagnostics/evidence table which Production
  87: also writes. The approved D48 boundary exception is deliberately narrow: it
  88: supports run-owned Replay diagnostic evidence plus one read-only Production
  89: diagnostic display. It cannot participate in a Replay decision, parity
  90: classification, qualification, entry, exit, sizing, or lifecycle transition.
  91: 
  92: The permitted run-owned operations are:
  93: 
  94: ```sql
  95: DELETE FROM fix122_evaluation WHERE test_run_id IS NOT NULL
  96: ```
  97: 
  98: For the eventual baseline, this is an explicit table allow-list exception, not
  99: an untracked boundary violation. The allow-list and static reachability tests
 100: must permit only the following exact operations:
 101: 
 102: - read, insert, and query rows whose `test_run_id` identifies the active
 103:   Replay run;
 104: - the scoped purge above, never an unqualified delete and never a delete of a
 105:   row where `test_run_id IS NULL`;
 106: - the existing read-only display query `SELECT * FROM fix122_evaluation WHERE
 107:   test_run_id IS NULL AND symbol=? AND evaluated_at>=? AND evaluated_at<=?
 108:   ORDER BY id`. It may populate diagnostics display only and must not feed a
 109:   decision, parity result, fixture, or any mutable state;
 110: - no other select, insert, update, delete, repository, JDBC template, or
 111:   indirect access to this table.
 112: 
 113: The direct and background-task tests must fail the build for any operation
 114: outside this exact policy. Any other shared-table access remains forbidden.
 115: D48 remains open until the implemented policy and its direct/background-task
 116: tests prove these limits. RPR-0.9.12 adopts this owner decision. It remains a
 117: draft and is not an implementation authorization.

 132: ## 6. Mandatory logging registry
 133: 
 134: There is one registry only. Every Replay log starts
 135: `[FIX-156][REPLAY]`, includes `runId`, `profileHash`, `baselineHash`,
 136: `symbol`, and when present `fixtureId`, `signalId`, and `priceEventId`.
 137: Every time is displayed as stored UTC **and** KSA (`+03:00`). No credential,
 138: token, account number, raw SQL parameter, or unbounded payload is logged.
 139: 
 140: The only event IDs are:
 141: 
 142: - `RUN_REQUESTED`, `RUN_QUALIFIED`, `RUN_REFUSED`, `RUN_FAILED`, `RUN_PROMOTED`;
 143: - `FIXTURE_LOADED`;
 144: - `PRICE_SPAN`;
 145: - `DECISION`;
 146: - `FIRST_DIVERGENCE`;
 147: - `FORBIDDEN_DEPENDENCY`; and
 148: - `POLICY_FINGERPRINT`.
 149: 
 150: Event payloads include the RPR-0.9.10 required fields: reason/evidence counts,
 151: fixture hash/count, price-span boundaries/gap/refusal, decision path and
 152: Section-3.3.1 step, input event IDs, expected/actual first divergence, attempted
 153: class/method/table/URL, and policy source/configuration/profile identity.
 154: Volume is bounded by E05. Tests assert one correctly correlated event per
 155: occurrence.
 156: 
 157: A critical-safety mismatch is `ERROR` and **parity-not-earned**. Its mismatch
 158: certificate and first divergence are published. It never becomes
 159: `FAILED_REPLAY` merely because the result disagrees. `FAILED_REPLAY` means
 160: technical error/cancellation/failed staging and discards staged artifacts.
 161:

 193: ## 8. Completion criteria
 194: 
 195: Before any parity claim, actual changes must reconcile to the approved registry;
 196: all required tests and E01-E10 evidence must exist; the qualified/excluded/
 197: refused/non-comparable/censored buckets must be reported by cause and exit
 198: class; and the frozen coverage/count/lower-bound requirements must pass
 199: separately for both dimensions.
 200: 
 201: There must be **zero unexplained critical-safety mismatches** in stop-loss,
 202: profit-lock, take-profit, near-TP ownership and duplicate-exit classes. A
 203: qualified cohort may earn its applicable `ANALYSIS_PARITY` and/or
 204: `LIFECYCLE_PARITY` dimension only. It never earns account or exact-fill parity.

 213: ### E01 - dependency audit: confirmed current violations
 214: 
 215: The current Replay path is not inside the approved boundary yet:
 216: 
 217: - `wallet_settings` is Replay-reachable through `ShadowProductionReplayService`,
 218:   `OneCandleContinuationGraceReplayObserver`, and shared BUY validation.
 219: - Near-TP reaches live Binance `/api/v3/exchangeInfo` through
 220:   `BinanceMinimumExecutionPolicy`.
 221: - `wallet_trade` is read by the all-trades chart and proven-trade enrichment.
 222: - If Replay scope propagation is absent, `EntryConsumptionPolicy` and
 223:   `StopLossEvidenceStore` can fall through to Production-account reads.
 224: - Replay currently reads, writes, and performs the scoped run-owned purge on
 225:   shared `fix122_evaluation`; Section 4.2a defines the only allowed
 226:   transitional exception and its delete policy. Replay can also write
 227:   `shared_candle_input_audit` in shared-market LIVE mode.
 228: 
 229: The required future response is Replay-local policy/data adapters, immutable
 230: policy and exchange-constraint fixtures, the allow-listed Replay data-access
 231: layer, static reachability checks, and direct/async rejection tests. The E01
 232: audit must also decide whether every shared-table write is replaced by a
 233: Replay-owned record or made unreachable in the baseline.
 234: 
 235: RPR-0.9.12 records these formal boundary rows. They are not merely audit notes
 236: because each one must be closed, tested and reconciled:
 237: 
 238: | Proposed row | E01 boundary violation | Required disposition |
 239: | --- | --- | --- |
 240: | D47 | `OneCandleContinuationGraceReplayObserver` reads `wallet_settings`. | Remove from baseline invocation or feed only the frozen Replay policy profile. |
 241: | D48 | Replay reads, writes, and deletes from shared `fix122_evaluation`; the current delete is scoped to `test_run_id IS NOT NULL`, while Production also writes table rows. `StopLossEvidenceStore.productionDetails` separately reads `test_run_id IS NULL` rows for display. | Enforce Section 4.2a's exact run-owned and display-only allow-list/delete policy.
